attributes:ban-reason.5H9nMhQacZBD9Zomu7.description: Explanation sent to a banned user. When a moderator bans someone, this text (in the banned user's own language) prefills the ban message, which is inserted after "Reason:" in the ban email and on the /banned page shown when the user logs in. It begins with a short restatement of the reason ("Spam profile.", "Impersonation.") that reads as the label after "Reason:", followed by sentences addressed to the banned user. Banned users never see this name; they see the matching details text instead.

Alt text for a logo in the homepage press row: Flirtual's iDate Awards win (a dating-industry award) in the "Best New Technology" category. Keep "iDate Awards"; the category name may be translated.

flirtual:acidic_temporary_fill_cracker.description: Label of the optional checkbox on the sign-up form that subscribes the user to Flirtual's marketing/newsletter emails. The hint text below it (key spade_mindless_furry_jeans) continues the sentence: "…with new features, changes, and offers".

flirtual:active_frail_antelope_support.description: Second sentence in the machine-translation disclaimer box on non-English legal pages.

tags.contact: Link to the Contact Us/support page

flirtual:active_recently.description: Status next to a green dot on another user's profile photo, shown when they were last active between 1 day and 2 weeks ago. Sits on one line with distance and time-difference indicators.
flirtual:active_recently.lengthNote: Shares a line with other indicators on the photo; keep short

flirtual:active_subscription.description: Heading of the section on the subscription page listing the user's current plan(s), each with its status (renews/expires in N days).

flirtual:active_today.description: Status next to a green dot on another user's profile photo, shown when they were last active less than 24 hours ago. Sits on one line with distance and time-difference indicators.
flirtual:active_today.lengthNote: Shares a line with other indicators on the photo; keep short

flirtual:actual_stock_camel_devour.description: Notice beside a checkmark at the top of profile setup step 2, shown when the user's email is confirmed: their profile is now visible to others, and the remaining setup steps are optional. The heart icon is the browse button in the navigation bar.

flirtual:add.description: Button next to the "Prompts" heading that opens the dialog to add a profile prompt (a question with the user's written answer), and the confirm button inside that dialog that adds the prompt to the profile.

flirtual:add_a_prompt.description: Title of the prompt dialog when adding a new prompt (a question picked from a list plus the user's written answer) to the profile.

flirtual:add_confirm_email.description: Text under "One more step" for accounts created without an email (e.g. via Meta sign-in), above an email field and Continue button.

flirtual:add_passkey.description: Button (with a plus icon) that creates a new passkey on the current device. When passkeys aren't available, it's disabled and "(unsupported device)" or "(unsupported browser)" is appended after a space.

flirtual:add_password.description: Section heading above the password form, shown to users who signed up with a third-party login and have no password yet.

flirtual:add_password_help.description: Explanation under the "Add password" heading for users who only log in through a connected account (Discord, Google, Apple, Meta, etc.).

providers.meaning: The user's connected login providers, already joined as a locale-formatted "or" list

flirtual:added_date.description: Small secondary line under each passkey's name in the passkey list, saying when it was created.

date.meaning: Date the passkey was added, formatted as a locale short date

flirtual:advanced_filters.description: Name of the matchmaking feature that includes or excludes profiles by tag. Heading (with a Premium badge) of that section in matchmaking settings, and an item in the Premium features list on the subscription page.

flirtual:advanced_filters_description.description: Explanation under "Advanced filters". "Date Mode" is the product name of the dating side of browsing (vs. Homie Mode for friends); keep it consistent with your translation of that mode name.

flirtual:advanced_filters_exclude.description: Label of the tag picker whose tags hide a profile, in the user's voice; the selected tags complete the sentence.

flirtual:advanced_filters_exclude_hint.description: Hint under "I don't want to see...": profiles having any one of the selected tags are hidden.

flirtual:advanced_filters_include.description: Label of the tag picker whose tags a profile must have to be shown, in the user's voice; the selected tags complete the sentence.

flirtual:advanced_filters_include_hint.description: Hint under "I only want to see..." explaining the matching rule: within each category the selected tags are alternatives (any one is enough), and every category with a selection must be satisfied.

flirtual:advanced_filters_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the search box in both advanced filter tag pickers (include and exclude).

flirtual:advanced_filters_warning.description: Caution under the Advanced filters description: too many filters may leave no matching profiles to browse.

flirtual:age_blocked_description.description: Explanation under the "blocked as underaged" title on the full-screen age block card.

flirtual:age_blocked_title.description: Title of the full-screen card shown in the iOS/Android app when the phone's platform age signal (Apple/Google) reports the user as a minor. The app is unusable from here.

flirtual:age_range.description: Label of the two-handled slider setting the ages of people the user wants to see; the selected range is shown beside it (e.g. "25-35").

flirtual:age_unresolved_apple.description: Instructions on the age-check card on iPhone/iPad: the user has to share their age range with apps in the iOS Settings app, then tap "Try again". The path names real iOS Settings menu items, so match Apple's localized menu names; "[your name]" stands for the Apple Account name row at the top of Settings. Check your local version of Apple's docs for the exact navigation text: https://support.apple.com/122770

flirtual:age_unresolved_google.description: Instructions on the age-check card on Android: the user has to complete Google Play's own age verification, then tap "Try again". An "Open Google Play" button sits below.

flirtual:age_unresolved_title.description: Title of the full-screen card shown in the iOS/Android app when the user's platform requires an age check but they haven't shared their age with apps yet. Shown with a "Try again" button.

flirtual:age_verified.description: Tooltip on a checkmark badge next to a user's age on their profile photo, indicating their age has been verified.

flirtual:aloof_caring_niklas_fade.description: Onboarding tour step pointing at the Undo button, which goes back to the previous profile. "Undo" is the button name.

flirtual:android.description: Platform name Android, inserted into sentences on the subscription page like "Sorry, you can't make changes to this subscription in the {currentPlatform} app. Please use the {otherPlatform} app…" when a Premium subscription was bought on another platform. Normally left untranslated.

flirtual:anonymous.description: Fills the name slot of the avatar alt text ("{name}'s avatar") when no user is known for the avatar, so it reads "Anonymous's avatar".

flirtual:antsy_calm_mallard_expand.description: Intro text above the exit-survey reason dropdown on the delete-account page.

flirtual:antsy_great_spider_drum.description: Paragraph on the empty Matches page explaining that the browse queue prioritizes people who have already Liked or Homied the user, to help them match. "Like" and "Homie" are the app's two swipe actions.

flirtual:anyone_on_flirtual.description: Visibility option in privacy dropdowns choosing who can see a piece of profile info (personality, sexuality, country, kinks): every logged-in Flirtual user.

flirtual:app_store.description: Store name on the download button that links to Flirtual on Apple's App Store, under the small uppercase "Download on" line (like the official "Download on the App Store" badge). Use Apple's official localized name for the App Store.

flirtual:appearance.description: Title of the settings page for language, light/dark theme, font size and profile colors; also its item in the settings list.

flirtual:apple.description: Brand name Apple, as a sign-in provider (Sign in with Apple). Shown as the small label above the linked Apple account's name on its connection button, and in the list of providers in "…instead of {providers}" on the password settings page. Normally left untranslated.

flirtual:april_fools_year.description: Small hint next to a Fun stuff toggle saying which April Fools' Day prank it came from.

year.meaning: Year of the April Fools' joke

flirtual:aqua_depths.description: Name of a preset profile color gradient (light aqua to deep ocean blue). Creative name; adapt freely to fit the colors.
flirtual:aqua_depths.lengthNote: Maintainer: keep within ~15 characters so it fits above the swatch

flirtual:are_you_sure.description: Title of the confirmation dialog shown after tapping "Reset passes".

flirtual:attachments.description: Label of the image upload field in the report dialog, for screenshots or other evidence.

flirtual:attributes_admin.description: Admin-only link to the page for editing profile attributes (the selectable options like games, interests, genders). Shown with a tags icon.

flirtual:awake_few_wren_skip.description: Confirmation toast after saving the Basic info settings page.

flirtual:awake_solid_slug_flop.description: Description following "Innerworld: " (the name of a VR peer-support community) under the VR/PC/iOS heading.

flirtual:away_lime_hound_launch.description: Onboarding tour step pointing at the Pass button, which skips the current profile. "Pass" is the button name.

flirtual:back.description: Button with a left arrow that returns to the previous step of a multi-step form (profile setup, onboarding, login verification code). Also the accessible label of the back-arrow in full-screen select/autocomplete pickers on mobile.

flirtual:back_to_browsing.description: Button that leaves the page and returns to the dating browse screen: on step 1 of profile setup (skip for now) and on the page-not-found screen.

flirtual:back_to_matches.description: Button (and the accessible label of the back-arrow in the chat header on mobile) that returns from a chat to the Matches list.

flirtual:bad_ideal_stingray_amuse.description: Title of the onboarding tour step pointing at the Pass (skip) button.

flirtual:bad_jumpy_sheep_gasp.description: Explanation at the top of the debug page, above a Copy button and a block of technical JSON the user can send to support.

flirtual:bad_tangy_lynx_tend.description: Confirmation toast after saving the user's interests.

flirtual:banned_appeal_hint.description: Instructions above the text box of the expanded appeal form on the banned page, where the user writes why their ban should be lifted.

flirtual:banned_appeal_label.description: Clickable pink text on the banned page that expands an appeal form, for users banned for reasons other than age. Means to ask the moderators to reconsider the ban.

flirtual:banned_appeal_sent.description: Replaces the appeal form on the banned page once the user has sent an appeal (also on later visits).

flirtual:banned_appeal_submit.description: Submit button of the appeal form on the banned page; sends the user's appeal message to the moderators.

flirtual:banned_description.description: Paragraph on the banned page, under the date and time of the ban, explaining why the account was suspended.

flirtual:banned_reason.description: Line on the banned page giving the reason for the ban, with "Reason:" in bold followed by the moderator's explanation.

message.meaning: The ban reason: a moderator's free-text message or a standard ban reason description (already translated), may span several lines
message.example: Underaged. You must be at least 18 years of age to use Flirtual.

flirtual:banned_retention.description: Paragraph on the banned page telling the user how long their account data is kept after the ban before deletion.

tags.privacy: Link to the Privacy Policy page; wraps the link text

flirtual:banned_title.description: Title of the page a user sees when moderators have banned their account (and browser tab title). Addressed to the banned user; "suspended" here means the account is banned/blocked from use.

flirtual:banned_underage.description: Suspension reason shown on the account-suspended page when the account was suspended for possibly being under 18 and must verify age. Inserted after a bold "Reason:" prefix. "Underaged." is a terse reason label followed by the explanation.

flirtual:banned_verify_action.description: Button on the banned page (underage bans only) that takes the user to the age verification page. Imperative, said by the user ("Verify my age").

flirtual:banned_verify_hint.description: Shown on the banned page only when the user was banned for being under 18; above a button that opens age verification. Verifying they are 18+ lifts the ban.

flirtual:barbarous_hypnotic_thank_book.description: Explanation in the block confirmation dialog, between the title and the Cancel/Block buttons; also on the Apple Watch.

flirtual:basic_info.description: Name of the profile settings page for date of birth, gender, sexuality, country, timezone, languages, VR setup and games: settings menu item, page heading, and browser tab title via "{name} - Flirtual".

flirtual:basic_tense_mayfly_devour.description: Title of the onboarding tour step pointing at the matches/conversations button (or the matches sidebar on wide screens).

flirtual:basic_wide_ape_buy.description: Sentence appended (after a space) to the paragraph explaining why Premium exists, shown to users who have or had a subscription. "<3" is a literal text heart emoticon, not a markup tag; keep it or use an equivalent heart.

flirtual:big_that_insect_slurp.description: Technical detail line at the bottom of the error dialog in small monospace text, tap to copy. "Event" is the error-report ID in the crash-reporting system (Sentry) that support can look up.

flirtual:bio.description: Label of the rich-text field where the user writes their profile biography ("about me" text).

flirtual:bio_pics.description: Name of the profile section with the biography text and profile pictures: step 1 of the profile setup progress bar, the title of the bio settings page, and its entry in the settings menu. "pics" = pictures.
flirtual:bio_pics.lengthNote: Progress-bar segment, one of five on desktop

flirtual:block.description: Button with a ban icon at the bottom of another user's profile, and the confirm button in the block confirmation dialog. Blocking hides both profiles from each other and stops messaging. Also shown on the Apple Watch app.
flirtual:block.lengthNote: Small button; also on a watch screen

flirtual:block_name.description: Title of the confirmation dialog shown before blocking someone; also on the Apple Watch.

name.meaning: The other user's display name (or their profile link name)

flirtual:blue_calm_chipmunk_spark.description: Text under "VRChat worlds"; "them" are the worlds, which anyone can visit at any time and host their own events in.

flirtual:blue_lost_quail_support.description: Confirmation toast after the user saves their privacy settings.

flirtual:bluesky.description: Link to Flirtual's account on Bluesky, the social network. Brand name; normally left untranslated.

flirtual:born_game_pony_empower.description: Hint under "Custom interests" on non-Apple devices, telling the user to press the Enter key after typing each custom interest tag. Use the key name standard on PC/Android keyboards in this language.

tags.small: Small-text wrapper around the ⏎ key symbol; keep it right after the key name

flirtual:born_green_lion_tend.description: Paragraph on the empty Matches page explaining how matching works: a match happens when two people both Like (dating) or both Homie (friend request) each other, and matches can chat and meet up in VR. "Like" and "Homie" are the app's two swipe actions and are capitalized as feature names.

flirtual:born_sweet_nils_thrive.description: Confirmation toast after the user saves the NSFW settings form (show NSFW tags, dom/sub role, kinks, kink privacy).

flirtual:bounce_knot_legs_bell.0.description: Big caption over a full-screen photo in the homepage slideshow of things to do together on a VR date (slide 1 of 7, changes every 5 seconds). Phrased as a suggestion to the visitor. Caption for a VR world with a pond.
flirtual:bounce_knot_legs_bell.0.lengthNote: Very large text centered over the photo; keep it short

flirtual:bounce_knot_legs_bell.1.description: Big caption over a full-screen photo in the homepage slideshow of things to do together on a VR date (slide 2 of 7, changes every 5 seconds). Phrased as a suggestion to the visitor. The ellipsis is a comic pause before the surprise "with sharks"; keep the effect.
flirtual:bounce_knot_legs_bell.1.lengthNote: Very large text centered over the photo; keep it short

flirtual:bounce_knot_legs_bell.2.description: Big caption over a full-screen photo in the homepage slideshow of things to do together on a VR date (slide 3 of 7, changes every 5 seconds). Phrased as a suggestion to the visitor. Caption for a VR café world.
flirtual:bounce_knot_legs_bell.2.lengthNote: Very large text centered over the photo; keep it short

flirtual:bounce_knot_legs_bell.3.description: Big caption over a full-screen photo in the homepage slideshow of things to do together on a VR date (slide 4 of 7, changes every 5 seconds). Phrased as a suggestion to the visitor. Caption for a VR world in space.
flirtual:bounce_knot_legs_bell.3.lengthNote: Very large text centered over the photo; keep it short

flirtual:bounce_knot_legs_bell.4.description: Big caption over a full-screen photo in the homepage slideshow of things to do together on a VR date (slide 5 of 7, changes every 5 seconds). Phrased as a suggestion to the visitor. "Touch grass" is internet slang telling someone who is online too much to go outside; here it's a joke, since the grass is virtual. Use an equivalent idiom if one exists, otherwise a literal phrase.
flirtual:bounce_knot_legs_bell.4.lengthNote: Very large text centered over the photo; keep it short

flirtual:bounce_knot_legs_bell.5.description: Big caption over a full-screen photo in the homepage slideshow of things to do together on a VR date (slide 6 of 7, changes every 5 seconds). Phrased as a suggestion to the visitor. Caption for an art/painting VR world.
flirtual:bounce_knot_legs_bell.5.lengthNote: Very large text centered over the photo; keep it short

flirtual:bounce_knot_legs_bell.6.description: Big caption over a full-screen photo in the homepage slideshow of things to do together on a VR date (slide 7 of 7, changes every 5 seconds). Phrased as a suggestion to the visitor. "Pool" is the cue sport billiards, not a swimming pool.
flirtual:bounce_knot_legs_bell.6.lengthNote: Very large text centered over the photo; keep it short

flirtual:branding.description: Link to and title of the Branding page, which offers Flirtual's logos and brand assets and their usage rules (a brand/press kit).

flirtual:brave_bald_bison_trim.description: Shown under the reason dropdown when the user picks "I'm taking a break", suggesting deactivation instead of deletion.

tags.deactivateLink: Link to the deactivate-account settings page

flirtual:brave_late_dolphin_dart.description: Description under the "See who Likes you before you match" benefit heading, shown to users without an active subscription. "Liked" is the app's Like action (expressing interest in someone's profile).

flirtual:broad_upper_ox_drum.description: Explanation under the Passkeys heading, above the list of the user's passkeys and the "Add passkey" button.

flirtual:browse.description: Browser tab/page title for the main dating browse screen, where the user swipes through dating profiles. Inserted into "{name} - Flirtual". A noun-like page name, not a command.

flirtual:browse_profiles.description: Button on the empty Matches page that goes to the dating browse screen.

flirtual:calm_calm_alligator_taste.description: Subtitle under the main headline at the top of the homepage, describing Flirtual as a dating app for virtual reality.

flirtual:cancel.description: Generic cancel button that closes a confirmation dialog without doing anything: e.g. the reset-passes confirmation, the block-user and report-user dialogs, and the block confirmation on the Apple Watch app (plain text there).

flirtual:canceled_on_date.description: Status line under the name of an ended plan, giving the date its Premium access ended. Keep the ICU date format "{date, date, long}" unchanged.

date.meaning: Date the plan's access ended, rendered as a long localized date

flirtual:careful_wise_bumblebee_walk.description: Description of the Flirtual Speed Dating VRChat world. "Rounds" are timed one-to-one conversations; "night mode" is a darker lighting setting in the world; "interest tags" are the topics people list on their profiles.

flirtual:caring_smug_felix_gleam.description: Warning after a ⚠️ emoji under the user's subscription when it was bought in the other mobile app's store (e.g. bought on Android, viewed in the iOS app), so it can't be changed here.

currentPlatform.meaning: Platform of the app the user is using now (translated "iOS" or "Android")

otherPlatform.meaning: Platform where the subscription was bought (translated "iOS" or "Android")

flirtual:casual.description: Label on the Homie Mode switch in the top navigation, shown only when the user turned on the joke "ranked mode" in Fun settings. Pairs with "Ranked" on the Date Mode switch, parodying competitive video game matchmaking (ranked vs. casual queues), so it means casual play, not casual dating.
flirtual:casual.lengthNote: Short label beside an icon in the navigation bar

flirtual:casual_dating.description: Tag option under "Looking for" in the advanced filters: people seeking casual, VR-only dating (elsewhere described as "Casual dating (VR-only dating)").

flirtual:casual_dating_hint.description: Checkbox option under "I'm open to…": dating that stays in virtual reality only, without meeting in person.

flirtual:change_email.description: Title of the settings page for changing the account's email address.

flirtual:change_password.description: Section heading above the password form, shown when the user already has a password. Alternative heading for users without one is "Add password".

flirtual:chat_unavailable.description: Header shown in place of a chat when the conversation can't be opened because the other person is no longer available.

flirtual:chat_unavailable_description.description: Explanation under "Chat unavailable" listing possible reasons the other user is gone (unmatched, deactivated, or removed by moderators) without revealing which. "They" is the other user.

flirtual:check_this_out_for_free.description: Link appended after a space to three Premium benefit descriptions (matchmaking priorities, advanced filters, profile colors). It opens the related settings page, where free users can try out or preview the feature. Parentheses are part of the text.

flirtual:chunky_lost_parrot_roam.description: Text heart emoticon used as a sign-off line just before "The Flirtual Team" at the end of the final onboarding tour note. Keep as an emoticon; adapt only if a different text heart is more natural.

flirtual:chunky_weak_tadpole_relish.description: Instruction above the interest picker: pick at most 10 interests; a field for adding custom (free-text) interests is further down the page.

flirtual:chunky_zany_leopard_peek.description: Onboarding tour step pointing at the Date Mode / Homie Mode switch. Date Mode is browsing for dating, Homie Mode for friends. The <span> tags are raw HTML that keep each icon with its mode name on one line; copy them unchanged.

heart.meaning: Inline heart icon (HTML) for Date Mode; not text

homie.meaning: Inline peace-sign icon (HTML) for Homie Mode; not text

tags.span: Raw HTML <span class="whitespace-nowrap"> wrapping icon + mode name so they don't wrap apart; keep the class attribute exactly

flirtual:civil_active_nils_value.description: Premium benefit, prefixed by a ♾️ emoji. For subscribers it links to the browsing (discover) page; for non-subscribers it is a bold heading followed by a description. Free users have a daily limit on profiles they can browse.

flirtual:clean_extra_goldfish_pause.description: Variant of the notice at the top of profile setup step 2 shown when the user's email isn't confirmed yet (so the profile isn't visible yet): the profile is ready, and the remaining steps are optional. The heart icon is the browse button in the navigation bar.

flirtual:cleared_count_reports.description: Moderator-only confirmation toast after clearing all open reports on a profile, from the moderation queue or a profile's moderation menu.

flirtual:cleared_single_report.description: Moderator-only confirmation toast after clearing (dismissing) one user report in the moderation queue.

flirtual:close.description: Close action: screen-reader label of the X button that dismisses a banner, the button on the last page of the What's New dialog, and the button that closes the report sheet on the Apple Watch after a report was sent. Imperative verb.

flirtual:close_cozy_salmon_praise.description: Tooltip on the third of three theme screenshots: the option that follows the device's light/dark mode setting automatically.

flirtual:colors.description: Section heading on the branding page above swatches of the brand colors.

flirtual:comment.description: Label of the optional free-text box where the user can explain why they're deleting their account. Noun.

flirtual:committee_trucks_welcome_approv.description: Full text of the Terms of Service (rules, safety, content, privacy, purchases, third parties, rights, security, disclaimers, governing law), rendered as rich text. 'ROVR LABS INC.' stays as-is. The maintainer says don't worry about this one unless you're confident translating legal policies; a machine translation is shown with a disclaimer that the English version governs.

tags.privacy: Link to the Privacy Policy page
tags.guidelines: Link to the Community Guidelines page
tags.payments: Link to the Payment Terms page
tags.delete-account: Link to the account deletion page in Settings
tags.ssltest: Link to an external SSL Labs test of the site's encryption

flirtual:community_guidelines.description: Name of Flirtual's community rules document: link in settings and footer, title of the /guidelines page, and a small link at the bottom of warning messages from moderators.

flirtual:complete_your_profile.description: Title of the card shown instead of profiles in the browse screen when the user hasn't finished setting up their profile. Instruction addressed to the user.

flirtual:confirm_current_password.description: Label of a field where the user re-enters their existing password to authorize a sensitive change (deleting the account, changing email or password).

flirtual:confirm_email.description: Button on the browse page's "Confirm your email" card (shown when the user hasn't confirmed their email address) that opens the email-confirmation page; also the browser tab title of that page. Imperative: confirm your email address.

flirtual:confirm_email_address.description: Label of the second email field in the change-email form, where the user re-types the new email to make sure it matches. A noun phrase for the re-entry field ("email confirmation"), not the action of confirming via the emailed link.

flirtual:confirm_new_email_address.description: Label of the second field where the user re-types the new email address to check for typos.

flirtual:confirm_new_password.description: Label for the second password field (type the new password again) on the set-new-password form reached from the reset email link.

flirtual:confirm_password.description: Label of the field where the user re-types the new password to confirm it matches.

flirtual:confirm_your_email.description: Card title shown instead of profiles in the browse screen when the user hasn't confirmed their email address, and the title of the email confirmation page. An instruction addressed to the user.

flirtual:connect_account.description: Text on a linked-account tile (Discord, VRChat, Apple, Google, Meta…) when that account isn't connected yet; clicking starts linking it. Shown under the service name, and replaced by the account's username once linked.
flirtual:connect_account.lengthNote: Single line in a narrow tile, cut off with an ellipsis when too long

flirtual:connection.description: Submenu in the moderator/admin profile dropdown's Copy menu, listing the user's linked accounts (Discord, VRChat) to copy. Noun, a linked external account. Only staff see it.

flirtual:connections.description: Name of the page where users link external accounts (Discord, VRChat, Meta, Apple, Google) to their profile and login. Used as the page heading, settings menu item, browser tab title, and a step name in the profile-setup progress bar. Means linked accounts, not social connections between people.

flirtual:console_message.description: Banner logged to the browser's developer console when the web app starts, aimed at developers who open the console. It's followed by the "Translate" and "Source code" lines with links.

flirtual:contact_us.description: Generic "Contact us" link/button: opens the support chat widget or support ticket page. Used as a section heading above the press email on /press, as a link on the full-page error screen, at the bottom of moderator warning dialogs, and mid-sentence after "Need help?" (followed by a period) on the account deletion form.

flirtual:continue.description: Generic button to proceed: the default label of form submit buttons across the app, the next-step button in the guided app tour, and the button after age verification succeeds.

flirtual:continue_browsing.description: Secondary button in the "It's a match!" dialog that closes it and returns to browsing profiles.
flirtual:continue_browsing.lengthNote: Also a full-width button on the Apple Watch screen

flirtual:continue_with.description: Label for a third-party sign-in button (also its accessible label when only the provider's icon is shown).

type.meaning: Name of the login provider (a brand name, not translated)

flirtual:copied.description: Replaces "Copy details" on the small text button of the crash/error screen after the error report has been copied, followed by a check-mark icon.

flirtual:copy.description: Verb: copy to the clipboard. Used as a button that copies debug details on the debug page, as the header of a profile's "Copy" submenu (items: display name, profile link, user ID), and as screen-reader text on the copy icon next to usernames on profiles.

flirtual:copy_details.description: Small text button at the bottom of the crash/error screen that copies a technical bug report (error, URL, version) to the clipboard to send to support.

flirtual:copy_frighten_wobble_futuristic.description: Role shown under an outside advisor's name in the team list on the About page.
Job title shown under a team member's name and avatar in the team list on the About page.
Role shown under team members who host Flirtual's events in VRChat (speed dating, parties) in the team list on the About page.
Job title shown under a team member's name and avatar in the team list on the About page; this person handles business partnerships and user safety.
Credit shown under a collaborator's name in the About page team list: an artist who builds VRChat worlds (3D virtual spaces) for Flirtual. Keep "VRChat" as is.
Credit shown under a collaborator's name in the About page team list: an artist who makes VRChat avatars (3D characters) for Flirtual. Keep "VRChat" as is.
Job title shown under a team member's name and avatar in the team list on the About page.
Role shown under each of several community moderators' names in the team list on the About page (volunteer content/safety moderators).
Team role meaning the person runs Flirtual's social media accounts. Not assigned to anyone in the current About page team list.

flirtual:copy_link.description: Button in the share dialog that copies your profile link to the clipboard.

flirtual:copyright.description: Copyright notice at the bottom of the settings list, the site footer and the error/maintenance screen. Keep the © symbol and the brand name Flirtual.

flirtual:countries.description: Category heading in the advanced filter tag picker, grouping country tags (Premium-only category).

flirtual:country.description: Label for the country selector on the profile (shown as a flag to others). In onboarding it is marked optional.

flirtual:country_privacy.description: Label of a dropdown choosing who can see the user's country on their profile: anyone on Flirtual, matches only, or just me.

flirtual:country_privacy_hint.description: Question shown as a hint next to the "Country privacy" label, above the who-can-see dropdown.

screens: dialog: Out of likes and passes
flirtual:cozy_such_jannes_laugh.description: Paragraph in the daily-limit dialog promoting the paid Premium subscription, which removes the daily limit and lets users see who has liked them.

tags.subscribeLink: Link to the Premium subscription page (/subscription)
tags.strong: Bold emphasis on each Premium benefit

flirtual:cream.description: Name shown on a brand color swatch for Flirtual's off-white cream color (#FFFAF0).

flirtual:create_account.description: Title of the sign-up page card, the browser tab title ("{name} - Flirtual"), and the submit button that creates an account from email and password. Imperative action, addressed to a new visitor.
flirtual:create_account.lengthNote: Also used as a small form button (min. ~11rem wide)

flirtual:crisis_hotlines.description: Heading above a list of suicide and crisis hotline links and phone numbers (the list items themselves stay in English).

flirtual:crisp_lime_raven_arise.description: Bold heading that appears on the loading screen when the app is slow to start, above a list of troubleshooting tips (check connection, refresh, contact us).

flirtual:cuddly_few_llama_catch.description: Confirmation toast after saving the profile bio and profile pictures. "Bio & pics" is also the name of this settings page.

flirtual:custom_interests.description: Label (with a pencil icon) of the free-text field where users type their own interest tags, as opposed to picking from the predefined list.

flirtual:cute_male_chipmunk_agree.description: In the iOS/Android app, the text on the tile for attaching screenshots to a user report; tapping opens the device's file picker. Replaces the website's "Drop here or browse".

flirtual:cute_smug_ocelot_flip.description: Note on the subscription page for users without an active subscription, telling them how to change or cancel after subscribing. "Manage" in quotes is the label of a button that appears on this page once subscribed; it must match the translation of that button (key "manage").

flirtual:dark.description: Dark color theme (dark mode), an option in the small theme dropdown in the page footer and on login/sign-up cards (with Light and System).

flirtual:dark_as_my_soul.description: Name of a preset profile color "gradient" that is solid black; a tongue-in-cheek edgy joke. Creative name; adapt freely.
flirtual:dark_as_my_soul.lengthNote: Maintainer: keep within ~15 characters so it fits above the swatch

flirtual:dark_mode.description: Name shown on a brand color swatch: the purple-pink gradient used when the app is in dark mode. Translate as the usual name for the app's dark theme.

flirtual:dark_theme.description: Tooltip on the screenshot button that switches the app to its dark color theme.

flirtual:dark_theme_image.description: Not text: the ID of the uploaded screenshot image shown for the Dark theme option. Copy it exactly, unchanged.

flirtual:dark_theme_preview.description: Screen-reader alt text for the screenshot showing the app in dark theme, on the theme selection button.

flirtual:date_of_birth.description: Label of the birthday picker on the user's basic profile info, used to show age and enforce the 18+ requirement.

flirtual:dates.description: Tab label in the native iOS/Android app's bottom tab bar (heart icon) for browsing dating profiles. Plural noun in the sense of romantic dates/dating matches; sits beside the "Homies" tab (browsing for friends), "Matches", "Settings" and "Profile".
flirtual:dates.lengthNote: Bottom tab bar label with five tabs; keep it to one short word

flirtual:day_crazy_tortoise_read.description: Text under the "VRChat group" heading on the Events page, above a "Join group" button. A VRChat group is a community feature in VRChat; "group instances" are VRChat sessions open only to group members.

flirtual:day_front_cat_cry.description: Confirmation shown after submitting a report about a user (as a toast on web/mobile, as a screen message on the Apple Watch).

flirtual:deactivate_account.description: Title of the deactivate-account page, its confirm button, and its item in the settings list. Deactivation temporarily hides the profile and can be undone; it is different from deleting the account.

flirtual:deactivated_account.description: Confirmation toast after the user deactivates (temporarily hides) their account.

flirtual:debug_information.description: Title of the debug page that shows technical details (app version, device, user ID) for support; also in the browser tab title.

flirtual:default_.description: Adjective meaning the default/standard setting. Used in two places: as a small gray label next to "Flirtual" on the default profile color preset, and as the name of the middle (normal) step of the Font size slider, shown next to the label (clicking it resets the size).

flirtual:deft_raw_cod_fond.description: Tagline in the site footer (desktop only), "Made with ♥ in VR". The heart emoji is a button that changes to a random heart on hover or click.

tags.action: Clickable heart that switches to a random heart emoji; must wrap {heart}

flirtual:delete_account.description: Title of the permanent account deletion page and its final submit button.

flirtual:delete_image.description: Action that removes a picture. In the profile picture editor it's a screen-reader label on a trash icon over each picture. In the moderators' full-size image view it's a tooltip on a trash icon and the confirm button of the "delete illegal image" dialog.

flirtual:delete_lifetime_warning.description: Warning (with ⚠️) on the delete-account page for users who bought Lifetime Premium (one-time purchase). "Lifetime Premium" is the product name.

flirtual:delete_subscription_apple.description: Second line of the App Store subscription warning on the delete-account page.

tags.appStoreLink: Link to Apple's subscription management page; wraps the instruction text

flirtual:delete_subscription_cancel.description: Note on the delete-account page for users whose Premium subscription was bought outside the App Store; Flirtual cancels it automatically.

flirtual:delete_subscription_warning.description: Warning box (with ⚠️) on the delete-account page for users with an App Store (Apple) subscription; followed by instructions to cancel it in the App Store.

flirtual:details.description: Used in two senses: (1) the name of step 2 of the profile setup progress bar ("Bio & pics / Details / Interests / Personality / Connections"), meaning more profile details such as relationship goals and sexuality; (2) the label of the free-text field in the report-a-user dialog (and watch report screen) where the reporter describes the problem. A short noun in both cases.
flirtual:details.lengthNote: Progress-bar segment, one of five on desktop
flirtual:details.resolved: One word must serve both the profile-setup step (profile details) and the report form's free-text field (report details); pick a word that works for both. (Splitting the key was suggested to the maintainer.)

flirtual:developers.description: Link to Flirtual's open-source code on GitHub, aimed at software developers who want to see or contribute to the code. Means "for developers".

flirtual:device.description: Sits next to "Debug information" and "Session" in the message file, but no current code renders it (the only match is an internal log name). Most likely a heading for device details on the debug page.
flirtual:device.resolved: Not rendered by current code; translate plainly as the noun 'device' (hardware). (Possible removal reported to the maintainer.)

flirtual:dirty_pink_puffin_flow.description: Default placeholder in the delete-account comment box for any reason other than having found a relationship.

flirtual:discord.description: The brand name Discord (chat app). Used as the label above a linked Discord account on the connection buttons, in the list of sign-in methods on the password settings page, and as a link to Flirtual's Discord community server in the profile menu and error dialog footer. Usually left untranslated.

flirtual:discord_server.description: Link to Flirtual's community server on Discord (the chat platform), under the "Social" heading. Keep the brand name Discord.

flirtual:discord_username.description: Line next to a Discord icon on a profile (visible to matches and on your own profile) showing the person's Discord username. A copy button and, if linked, a verified badge follow it.

tags.copy: Wraps the username; a link to their Discord profile when their account is linked, otherwise plain text

flirtual:discord_verified.description: Tooltip on a checkmark badge next to a profile's Discord username, meaning the Discord account was linked via sign-in rather than typed in.

flirtual:display_name.description: Label of the field where the user sets the name shown on their profile. Also a menu item in a profile's "Copy" submenu that copies that person's display name.

flirtual:distance_around_km.description: Tooltip on the distance indicator (map pin) on another user's profile photo giving an approximate, rounded distance. The indicator shows e.g. "~500km".

distance.meaning: Approximate distance in kilometres, rounded to a bucket

flirtual:distance_around_mi.description: Tooltip on the distance indicator (map pin) on another user's profile photo giving an approximate, rounded distance, for miles countries. The indicator shows e.g. "~250mi".

distance.meaning: Approximate distance in miles, rounded to a bucket

flirtual:distance_over_km.description: Tooltip on the distance indicator (map pin) on another user's profile photo when they are farther than the largest bucket. The indicator shows e.g. "2000km+".

flirtual:distance_over_mi.description: Tooltip on the distance indicator (map pin) on another user's profile photo when they are farther than the largest bucket, for miles countries. The indicator shows e.g. "1000mi+".

flirtual:distance_within_km.description: Tooltip on the distance indicator (map pin) on another user's profile photo when they are in the closest distance bucket. The indicator itself shows the compact value, e.g. "<100km".

flirtual:distance_within_mi.description: Tooltip on the distance indicator (map pin) on another user's profile photo when they are in the closest distance bucket, for users in miles countries. The indicator itself shows e.g. "<50mi".

flirtual:dizzy_fair_goat_propel.description: Error toast when the email confirmation link the user opened fails; they are sent to the confirm-email page to request a new one.

flirtual:dob_contact_to_correct.description: Warning toast when the user taps the locked (disabled) date-of-birth field; the birthday can't be self-edited once locked, so they must contact support.

flirtual:dominant.description: BDSM role (the person who prefers to be in control), part of the opt-in adult (NSFW) feature alongside Submissive and Switch. Shown as a profile tag, as an option in the Role advanced filter, and as a matchmaking-priority slider label (shown to submissive users, meaning "prefer dominant people").

flirtual:domsubswitch_match.description: Matchmaking priority slider label, shown only to users with the adult NSFW feature on who haven't set their own BDSM role: weight given to compatible dominant/submissive/switch roles. Dom, sub and switch are BDSM terms; use the terms common in your language's kink community. A multiplier is shown on the same line.

flirtual:dont_show_again.description: Small text button under the liking-streak warning banner that permanently hides that warning.

flirtual:download.description: Used both as a button that downloads the press kit ZIP (branding and press pages) and as the title of the Download page, which lists app-store buttons for getting the app; also in the browser tab title ("Download - Flirtual"). Needs to work as a short button verb and as a page title.

flirtual:download_on.description: Small uppercase line on an app store download button. The store name (App Store, Google Play, Microsoft Store, SideQuest) is a separate string shown on the line below, so this is the first half of "Download on / App Store". Shared by all four stores, so it can't agree with a specific store name.
flirtual:download_on.lengthNote: Tiny uppercase caption above the store name on a compact badge-style button

flirtual:drab_game_myna_yell.description: Heading of the section where users link their Discord, VRChat and Meta accounts to their Flirtual profile.

flirtual:drab_lucky_lemming_feel.description: Paragraph near the bottom of the subscription page explaining why Premium exists. It is immediately followed, in the same paragraph after a space, by either "We appreciate your continued support <3" or "Consider subscribing today!".

number.meaning: Total number of Flirtual users, already formatted for the locale

flirtual:drab_white_lionfish_nurture.description: Red error under the playlist field after the user submits a Deezer short-link; asks them to open it and paste the full deezer.com address instead. Keep domain names unchanged.

flirtual:dry_inclusive_ox_trust.description: Note at the end of the VRChat worlds section. PCVR (PC-based VR), Quest (Meta's headsets) and Desktop (non-VR on a computer) are the VRChat platforms the worlds support.

tags.faxmashine: Link to the website of Faxmashine, the world creator (a person's handle; don't translate); wraps the name
tags.vrchat: Link to the VRChat website; wraps the sign-up text

flirtual:dry_tame_sloth_yell.description: Wellbeing reminder in the final onboarding tour step's note (VR sessions can be long).

flirtual:dull_steep_tadpole_grin.description: Banner on the subscription page in the Apple Vision Pro app, for users who already have Premium; subscriptions can't be managed there.

flirtual:each_aloof_parrot_dine.description: Title of the dialog shown when the app hits an unexpected error. "We" is the Flirtual team.

flirtual:each_ideal_seahorse_bump.description: Error shown in the upload widget when a picture couldn't be uploaded or processed (including images too large in pixels).

flirtual:early_quiet_giraffe_dine.description: Reminder shown in italics on your own profile in place of the bio when you haven't written one.

flirtual:east_low_niklas_list.description: Confirmation toast after saving the matchmaking settings.

flirtual:edit.description: Button with a pencil icon on your own profile that opens Bio & Pics Settings to edit your profile. Sits beside the Share button.
flirtual:edit.lengthNote: Half-width button in a two-column row

flirtual:edit_profile.description: Button in the safety reminder about a Discord username in the profile; opens the bio editor so the user can remove it.

flirtual:edit_prompt.description: Title of the prompt dialog when changing an existing prompt on the user's profile. A prompt is a question picked from a list plus the user's written answer.

flirtual:elegant_actual_ray_buzz.description: Error in the anti-bot check box on login and sign-up when Cloudflare Turnstile reports the browser/device isn't supported. Followed by a small error code; tapping retries.
flirtual:elegant_actual_ray_buzz.lengthNote: Shares one line with an error code inside a fixed 300px-wide box

flirtual:email.description: "Email" as in the user's email address: the settings menu item and tab title for the page where users change their email, and the label of the email field on the password-reset form.

flirtual:email_address.description: Label of the email input on the login, sign-up, forgot-password and confirm-email forms. Also a menu item in a profile's "Copy" submenu (admins only) that copies that user's email address.

flirtual:email_changed.description: Toast after the user changes their email address on the confirm-email page (a new confirmation email is sent to it).

flirtual:emails.description: Tooltip on the envelope icon heading the email column of the notification settings grid; the checkboxes below it turn each email notification type on or off.

flirtual:empty_petty_bullock_drop.description: Explanation under the accounts heading: linked usernames are shown only to people you've matched with, so you can meet up in VR; some linked accounts can also be used to log in. Discord, VRChat, Meta, Google and Apple are brand names.

flirtual:enable.description: Button under the Location setting when no location is saved yet; asks for the device location and turns location-based matching on. Verb applies to the location feature.

flirtual:enable_assistant.description: Label of a switch that turns on "Flitty", a joke cat dating-assistant character from the April Fools 2025 prank (Clippy-style) that floats over the app and says silly lines. "Assistant" means this helper character.

flirtual:enable_distance_matchmaking.description: Label of an on/off switch that lets the app use the user's approximate location so people closer to them are shown more in matchmaking. Appears in onboarding and in a news dialog that announced the feature.

flirtual:enable_ranked_mode.description: Label of a switch that turns on the April Fools 2024 joke "ranked mode", which relabels the dating and friends mode switches as "Ranked" and "Casual", like competitive video game modes.

flirtual:enter_verification_code.description: Heading of the login step where the user must type a 6-digit code emailed to them (shown after email/password when the login looks new or risky).

flirtual:enter_verification_code_descrip.description: Instructions under the heading on the email login code step, above six digit boxes.

email.meaning: User's account email address the code was sent to

flirtual:equal_quaint_swallow_dial.description: Description following "Chill & Advice: " (the name of a Discord support server) under the Discord heading. "Vetted advisors" are screened volunteer helpers.

flirtual:errors.account_banned.description: Error when a suspended (banned) user tries to log in or use the app. "Appeal" means asking moderators to reverse the suspension.

flirtual:errors.account_deletion_failed.description: Error shown on the account deletion page when deleting the account fails on the server.

flirtual:errors.ambiguous_age.description: Shown under the date of birth field when the date entered makes the user (possibly) younger than 18.

flirtual:errors.are_still_associated_wit.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. Technical database message (multiple related records) that users should rarely see; same English as is_still_associated_with_this_entry.

flirtual:errors.authorize_not_supported.description: Error shown (in a toast, or in red at the top of the login/sign-up page after the redirect back) when logging in, signing up, or linking an account with a third-party provider (Google, Apple, Discord, Meta, VRChat): the provider can't be used this way. The parenthesized part is a short technical hint for support; translating it is fine, but keep it brief.

flirtual:errors.cannot_block_user.description: Error toast when blocking a profile fails because that account is deactivated.

flirtual:errors.cannot_unblock_user.description: Error toast when unblocking a profile fails because that account is deactivated.

flirtual:errors.cant_be_blank.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. The field was left empty but is required.

flirtual:errors.checkout_not_available.description: Error when starting a Premium purchase is refused. Shown to users barred from making payments, so it's deliberately vague; keep it neutral and non-accusatory.

flirtual:errors.connection_email_change_.description: Error when removing a linked login provider whose email is still the account's email; the user must change their Flirtual account email first.

flirtual:errors.connection_email_require.description: Error when removing a linked login provider (e.g. Google) from an account that has no email of its own, which would lock the user out.

flirtual:errors.connection_error_generic.description: Error shown (in a toast, or in red at the top of the login/sign-up page after the redirect back) when logging in, signing up, or linking an account with a third-party provider (Google, Apple, Discord, Meta, VRChat): fallback when the specific error is unknown. "(unknown error)" is a technical hint for support.

flirtual:errors.connection_in_use.description: Error shown (in a toast, or in red at the top of the login/sign-up page after the redirect back) when logging in, signing up, or linking an account with a third-party provider (Google, Apple, Discord, Meta, VRChat): that external account is already linked to a different Flirtual account. "Account" in the first sentence means the external account (e.g. Discord).

flirtual:errors.connection_no_account.description: Error shown (in a toast, or in red at the top of the login/sign-up page after the redirect back) when logging in, signing up, or linking an account with a third-party provider (Google, Apple, Discord, Meta, VRChat): the user tried to log in with a provider that isn't linked to any Flirtual account.

flirtual:errors.connection_verify_email.description: Error shown (in a toast, or in red at the top of the login/sign-up page after the redirect back) when logging in, signing up, or linking an account with a third-party provider (Google, Apple, Discord, Meta, VRChat): the provider reports the user's email as unverified, so they must verify it with that provider first.

flirtual:errors.conversation_not_found.description: Server error message shown in a red toast or form error list when opening a chat that no longer exists. The parenthesis lists possible reasons: the match was undone, one user blocked the other, deactivated their account, or was suspended.

flirtual:errors.does_not_match_confirmat.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. The "confirm" field doesn't match the original (e.g. password confirmation).

flirtual:errors.email_domain_blocked.description: Shown when signing up or changing email with an address from an email provider (domain) Flirtual blocks, typically disposable-email services used for spam.

flirtual:errors.email_in_use.description: Error shown (in a toast, or in red at the top of the login/sign-up page after the redirect back) when logging in, signing up, or linking an account with a third-party provider (Google, Apple, Discord, Meta, VRChat): signing up with a provider whose email already belongs to an existing Flirtual account.

flirtual:errors.email_must_be_different.description: Shown under the new email field when it's identical to the current account email.

flirtual:errors.email_required.description: Error shown (in a toast, or in red at the top of the login/sign-up page after the redirect back) when logging in, signing up, or linking an account with a third-party provider (Google, Apple, Discord, Meta, VRChat): the provider account has no email address, so it can't be used to sign up.

flirtual:errors.geolocation_failed.description: Error toast when updating the user's location from their device fails. Not currently referenced in the code (kept for location errors).

flirtual:errors.geolocation_not_supporte.description: Error toast when the device/browser can't provide a location. Not currently referenced in the code (kept for location errors).

flirtual:errors.geolocation_permission_d.description: Error toast when the user's device/browser denies location access. Not currently referenced in the code (kept for location errors).

flirtual:errors.geolocation_rate_limit.description: Error toast when the user tries to update their profile location from their device too often (more than 3 times in a week).

flirtual:errors.has_already_been_taken.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. The value must be unique and someone else already uses it (e.g. a username or email).

flirtual:errors.has_an_invalid_entry.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. For multi-select fields: one of the chosen items isn't an allowed option.

flirtual:errors.has_invalid_format.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. The value doesn't match the expected pattern (e.g. a username with disallowed characters).

flirtual:errors.image_not_found.description: Server error message shown in a red toast or form error list when acting on a profile photo that no longer exists (e.g. it was removed).

flirtual:errors.internal_server_error.description: Server error message shown in a red toast or form error list when something unexpected fails on the server (also when a native Apple/Google sign-in returns nothing usable).

flirtual:errors.invalid_age.description: Shown under the date of birth field when the date is implausible (before 1901, or less than a year ago).

flirtual:errors.invalid_credentials.description: Error when the login email/password are wrong (also returned for an invalid session). The login form itself usually shows the longer variant with links.

flirtual:errors.invalid_credentials_comp.description: Error under the Log in button when the email or password is wrong.

tags.reset: Link to the password reset page
tags.help: Link to a support article about login/password problems

flirtual:errors.invalid_gender_selection.description: Shown under the gender selector when the user picked two genders that conflict with each other (certain gender options can't be selected together).

flirtual:errors.invalid_grant.description: Error shown (in a toast, or in red at the top of the login/sign-up page after the redirect back) when logging in, signing up, or linking an account with a third-party provider (Google, Apple, Discord, Meta, VRChat): the provider rejected the authorization (invalid grant). The parenthesized part is a short technical hint for support; translating it is fine, but keep it brief.

flirtual:errors.invalid_password.description: Shown under the current-password field when a logged-in user confirms a sensitive change (e.g. changing email or password) with the wrong password. "Log out" is the app's logout action.

flirtual:errors.invalid_playlist_url.description: Shown under the music playlist link field when the URL isn't a supported playlist link (Spotify, YouTube Music, Apple Music, Tidal, Amazon Music, Deezer, SoundCloud, Mixcloud).

flirtual:errors.invalid_token.description: Error when a login token (from Apple/Google sign-in) fails validation. "(invalid token)" is a technical hint for support.

flirtual:errors.is_invalid.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. Catch-all for an unacceptable value.

flirtual:errors.is_reserved.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. The value (e.g. a username) is on a blocklist of reserved names and can't be used.

flirtual:errors.is_still_associated_with.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. Technical database message (single related record) that users should rarely see; same English as the plural-form key are_still_associated_with_this_entry.

flirtual:errors.leaked_password.description: Shown under the new password field when the chosen password appears in a known data breach (checked against a public breach database).

flirtual:errors.login_rate_limit.description: Error under the Log in button after too many failed password attempts.

tags.reset: Link to the password reset page

flirtual:errors.missing_permission.description: Server error message shown in a red toast or form error list when the user tries something they aren't allowed to do (e.g. moderator-only actions or someone else's profile).

flirtual:errors.missing_token.description: Error when an Apple/Google sign-in on the mobile app returns without the expected login token. "(missing token)" is a technical hint for support.

flirtual:errors.must_be_accepted.description: Validation error shown in red under the sign-up checkbox for agreeing to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy when it was left unchecked. It comes from the server's "must be accepted" check, or from the app after the user tries a Google/Discord/Apple sign-up twice without ticking the box.
flirtual:errors.must_be_accepted.lengthNote: Short inline field error under a checkbox

flirtual:errors.must_be_equal_to_{number.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. For number fields: the value must be exactly this number.

flirtual:errors.must_be_greater_than_{nu.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. For number fields: the value must be strictly above the limit.

flirtual:errors.must_be_greater_than_or_.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. For number fields: the value is below the minimum allowed.

flirtual:errors.must_be_less_than_{numbe.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. For number fields: the value must be strictly below the limit.

flirtual:errors.must_be_less_than_or_equ.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. For number fields: the value is above the maximum allowed.

flirtual:errors.must_have_the_@_sign_and.description: Shown in red under an email address field when the value isn't a valid email address.

flirtual:errors.must_include_a_non_prono.description: Shown under the gender selector when the user picked only pronoun options (e.g. they/them) without an actual gender; matchmaking needs at least one gender.

flirtual:errors.native_login_not_support.description: Error shown (in a toast, or in red at the top of the login/sign-up page after the redirect back) when logging in, signing up, or linking an account with a third-party provider (Google, Apple, Discord, Meta, VRChat): the chosen provider can't be used for sign-in in this app/device.

flirtual:errors.passkey_login_failed.description: Error when logging in with a passkey (device biometric/PIN login, WebAuthn) fails.

flirtual:errors.passkey_registration_fai.description: Error when adding a passkey (device biometric/PIN login, WebAuthn) to the account fails.

flirtual:errors.password_does_not_match.description: Shown under the confirm-password field when the two new password entries differ.

flirtual:errors.password_must_be_differe.description: Shown under the new password field when it's identical to the current password.

flirtual:errors.plan_not_available.description: Error when starting a Premium purchase fails because the selected plan isn't available; reassures the user they weren't charged.

flirtual:errors.profile_not_blocked.description: Error toast when unblocking a profile that isn't blocked anymore.

flirtual:errors.prospect_not_found.description: Error toast when the Undo action in browsing (bringing back the last profile you liked/passed) fails. Legacy key; the current server may not send it.

flirtual:errors.provider_not_found.description: Error shown (in a toast, or in red at the top of the login/sign-up page after the redirect back) when logging in, signing up, or linking an account with a third-party provider (Google, Apple, Discord, Meta, VRChat): the login provider isn't recognized. The parenthesized part is a short technical hint for support; translating it is fine, but keep it brief.

flirtual:errors.registration_failed.description: Error shown (in a toast, or in red at the top of the login/sign-up page after the redirect back) when logging in, signing up, or linking an account with a third-party provider (Google, Apple, Discord, Meta, VRChat): creating a new Flirtual account from the provider sign-up failed.

flirtual:errors.registration_rate_limit.description: Error on the account creation page when too many accounts were attempted from the same source.

flirtual:errors.report_not_found.description: Server error message shown in a red toast or form error list when a moderator acts on a user report that no longer exists (moderator-facing).

flirtual:errors.reset_password_link_inva.description: Red error shown at the top of the set-new-password form when the link from the reset email is invalid or expired.

tags.forgot: Link back to the password reset request page to get a new email

flirtual:errors.reset_password_rate_limi.description: Error on the password reset request page when too many reset emails were requested.

flirtual:errors.should_be_{count}_charac.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. The text must be exactly this many characters long.

flirtual:errors.should_be_at_least_{coun.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. Text is too short. The server counts bytes, but the message deliberately says characters; same English as the character version.

count.meaning: Minimum length (technically in bytes, shown to users as characters)

flirtual:errors.should_be_at_least_{coun.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. Text is too short; 0 or 1 is shown as "Required".

flirtual:errors.should_be_at_most_{count.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. Text is too long. The server counts bytes, but the message deliberately says characters.

count.meaning: Maximum length (technically in bytes, shown to users as characters)

flirtual:errors.should_be_at_most_{count.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. Text is too long.

flirtual:errors.should_have_{count}_item.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. For multi-select fields: exactly this many options must be chosen.

count.meaning: Exact number of items that must be selected

flirtual:errors.should_have_at_least_{co.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. For multi-select fields (e.g. interest tags): too few options chosen; 0 or 1 is shown as "Required".

count.meaning: Minimum number of items to select

flirtual:errors.should_have_at_most_{cou.description: Generic validation message shown in red under a form field when the server rejects its value; can appear on any form (sign-up, onboarding, settings). The field it refers to isn't named in the text. For multi-select fields (e.g. interest tags, limit 10): too many options chosen.

flirtual:errors.state_mismatch.description: Error shown (in a toast, or in red at the top of the login/sign-up page after the redirect back) when logging in, signing up, or linking an account with a third-party provider (Google, Apple, Discord, Meta, VRChat): a security check on the login redirect failed (state mismatch). The parenthesized part is a short technical hint for support; translating it is fine, but keep it brief.

flirtual:errors.subscription_not_found.description: Error when canceling a Premium subscription fails because no subscription is found. Legacy key; the current server may not send it.

flirtual:errors.token_expired.description: Error when an Apple/Google sign-in took too long and its login token expired.

flirtual:errors.turnstile_expired.description: Error when the automatic human-verification check (Cloudflare Turnstile anti-bot captcha) on login or sign-up expired or was already used.

flirtual:errors.turnstile_invalid.description: Error when the automatic human-verification check (Cloudflare Turnstile anti-bot captcha) on login or sign-up fails.

flirtual:errors.turnstile_required.description: Error shown under the CAPTCHA (Cloudflare Turnstile) check on login, sign-up and similar forms when it hasn't been completed; also returned by the server for the same reason.

flirtual:errors.upload_rate_limit.description: Error when uploading profile photos after hitting the upload limit (100 images per 12 hours).

flirtual:errors.upstream_error.description: Error shown (in a toast, or in red at the top of the login/sign-up page after the redirect back) when logging in, signing up, or linking an account with a third-party provider (Google, Apple, Discord, Meta, VRChat): the provider's servers returned an error. The parenthesized part is a short technical hint for support; translating it is fine, but keep it brief.

flirtual:errors.user_not_found.description: Server error message shown in a red toast or form error list when viewing or acting on a profile that's unavailable. Parenthesis lists reasons: blocked, account deactivated, or suspended.

flirtual:errors.verification_email_faile.description: Error on the login code step when the email with the 6-digit code couldn't be sent.

flirtual:errors.verification_invalid_cod.description: Error on the login code step when the 6-digit emailed code is wrong or expired.

flirtual:errors.verification_rate_limit.description: Error on the login step (or the 6-digit code step) after too many attempts to enter or resend the login code.

tags.reset: Link to the password reset page

flirtual:even_major_hare_believe.description: Large heading on the homepage section with press logos and a scrolling strip of user photos. The "+" after the number means "more than".

userCount.meaning: Total number of Flirtual users, formatted as a number

flirtual:even_trick_pelican_swim.description: Subheading under "Wrong email address?"; the colon introduces the form fields below it (new email, confirm email, current password).

flirtual:events.description: Link to and title of the Events page, which lists Flirtual's community events (VR meetups, livestreams, the Discord and VRChat group).

flirtual:every_agent_sloth_advise.description: Title of the last onboarding tour step, a thank-you note before the "Start matching" button.

flirtual:every_number_months.description: Billing period shown on its own line under the price on a multi-month plan card (e.g. "$29.99" then "every 3 months"). Lowercase in English, like "monthly".

number.meaning: Number of months in the billing period (only 3 or 6 are used)

flirtual:exit.description: Formerly a button in the guided app tour popovers that ended the tour early. Not referenced in the current code.

flirtual:expand_image.description: Screen-reader label on the expand icon over each picture in the profile picture editor; opens the picture full size.

flirtual:expires_in_days.description: Status line under an active plan that won't renew (canceled, or a fixed-term purchase), saying when Premium ends. Keep the ICU plural structure, including the =0 case.

count.meaning: Whole days until Premium access ends (counts days)

flirtual:extra_large.description: Name of the 6th of seven text-size steps on the Font size slider, shown beside the label while selected. Order: Tiny, Extra small, Small, Default, Large, Extra large, Huge.
flirtual:extra_large.lengthNote: Short label at the end of a label row

flirtual:extra_moving_jackdaw_twist.description: Accessible image description for screen readers on a person's avatar (profile picture). Used for every user avatar in the app and for team members on the About page.

name.meaning: Display name of the user or team member (or "Anonymous"/unnamed fallback)

flirtual:extra_small.description: Name of the 2nd-smallest of seven text-size steps on the Font size slider, shown beside the label while selected. Order: Tiny, Extra small, Small, Default, Large, Extra large, Huge.
flirtual:extra_small.lengthNote: Short label at the end of a label row

flirtual:exuberant_green_horse_fowl.description: Banner across the top of the app when the user hasn't confirmed their email address, so others can't see them yet.

tags.bannerLink: Link to the email confirmation page; wraps the call to action

flirtual:facetime_number.description: Placeholder of a text field for the user's FaceTime phone number or contact, shown only in the Apple Vision Pro app to internal testers. FaceTime is Apple's video-call app (brand name).

flirtual:factual_curly_fly_pop.description: Hint under the "Display name" field asking the user not to use their Discord username as their display name, to avoid scammers.

flirtual:fancy_noisy_grizzly_hint.description: Bold line at the top of an archived old version of the Terms of Service or Privacy Policy, linking to the version that replaced it.

range.meaning: Period the old policy applied, a date range already formatted for the locale

tags.otherPolicy: Link to the current version of the same policy

flirtual:few_grassy_hyena_adapt.description: Main heading of the last homepage section, above the app download buttons. "Whole new dimension" plays on virtual reality being a 3D world.

tags.highlight: Highlighted part of the heading, shown in the brand pink gradient

flirtual:filters.description: Button on the dating "Out of profiles" card that opens the matchmaking filters settings page. Plural noun (search filters for who you see).
flirtual:filters.lengthNote: Small button beside the "Homie Mode" button

flirtual:finish.description: Submit button on the last step of profile setup (and of onboarding) that saves and completes the flow. Imperative verb.
flirtual:finish.lengthNote: Button with a minimum width; keep it short

flirtual:finish_profile.description: Button on the browse page's "Complete your profile" card (shown when the user's profile setup isn't finished) that takes them to the profile setup steps. Imperative.

flirtual:flags.description: Moderator-only menu item opening the moderation flags page, where staff manage flagged words, phrases, blocked email domains and countries used to auto-flag accounts. Plural noun (warning flags), not the verb.

flirtual:flaky_early_shad_nourish.description: Sentence under the upcoming-events text on the Events page.

tags.discord: Link to Flirtual's Discord server invite; wraps the link text

flirtual:flaky_same_grizzly_snap.description: Usage rule under the "Our logo" heading on the branding page.

flirtual:flat_topical_hornet_nourish.description: Description under the "Browse unlimited profiles" benefit heading, shown to users without an active subscription. Free users can only browse a limited number of profiles per day.

flirtual:flesh_stitch_realize_bike.description: Banner across the top of the website when a translator/debug mode is on that shows raw translation keys instead of text. Not referenced in the current code.

tags.bannerLink: Link that turns the translation-key display mode off

flirtual:flirtual.description: The app's brand name. Used as the default browser tab title and social-share title, as alt text for the Flirtual logo, and as the name of the default profile color preset (followed by a gray "Default" label). Keep as the brand name; transliterate only if your language requires it.

flirtual:flirtual_bug_report.description: Clipboard label attached when the user copies error details from the crash/"having issues" screen (some systems show it as the copied item's name). The copied report itself stays in English.

flirtual:flirtual_logo.description: Alt text of the Flirtual wordmark logo image wherever it appears.

flirtual:flirtual_premium.description: Title of the subscription page card. "Flirtual" is the brand name; "Premium" is the name of the paid tier, translated consistently with other "Premium" strings.

flirtual:font_size.description: Label above a slider that changes the app's text size, followed by a "New" badge. The current size name (Tiny … Huge) is shown at the right of the label.
