flirtual:forgot_your_password.description: Small link shown beside the Password field label on the login form; goes to the password reset page.

flirtual:formal_dark_camel_hunt.description: Success message after the user sets a new password via the reset link; a Log in button appears below it.

flirtual:formal_icy_hound_type.description: Content rules for profile pictures, revealed by "Guidelines" under the "Profile pictures" field.

flirtual:fox_fire.description: Name of a preset profile color gradient (deep orange to light orange, fox-colored). Creative name; adapt freely to fit the colors.
flirtual:fox_fire.lengthNote: Maintainer: keep within ~15 characters so it fits above the swatch

flirtual:free_spirited.description: Personality tag pill on a profile, derived from the personality questions: low conscientiousness (opposite of "Reliable"); meant positively, as spontaneous. Also on the Apple Watch.

flirtual:friendly.description: Personality trait pill on a profile, derived from the personality quiz: high agreeableness, the opposite of "Straightforward". Describes the profile owner, whose gender varies; prefer a form that works for any gender. Also shown on the Apple Watch app.

flirtual:full_zesty_finch_exhale.description: First paragraph of the "Out of profiles" card in dating mode: the user has seen everyone who fits their matchmaking preferences.

flirtual:fun_stuff.description: Title of a hidden settings page (reached via an easter egg) with joke features from past April Fools' Days and the snowfall effect.

flirtual:fuzzy_calm_ant_nudge.description: Italic note on another person's profile, above their bio, shown when they are new to VR and you are not. Suggests you show them around VR.

name.meaning: The profile owner's display name (or "Unnamed user")

flirtual:galactic_glow.description: Name of a preset profile color gradient (light pink to deep violet, space-like). Creative name; adapt freely to fit the colors.
flirtual:galactic_glow.lengthNote: Maintainer: keep within ~15 characters so it fits above the swatch

flirtual:game_hint.description: Hint under the "VR apps/games" label, explaining that the chosen games are not a limit on where matched users can meet in VR.

flirtual:game_vexed_goldfish_dash.description: Troubleshooting step in the list on the error dialog/error page (native apps only) and the "taking longer than usual" loading tips: fully quit the app and start it again. Imperative.

flirtual:gender.description: Label for the gender field (checkbox list) when editing the profile in Basic info settings.

flirtual:genders.description: Category heading in the advanced filter tag picker, grouping gender tags.

flirtual:geolocation.description: Label of the control that lets the app use the device's location so matchmaking can prefer people who live nearby.

flirtual:geolocation_hint.description: Hint under the geolocation / distance-based matchmaking option, followed by an expandable "Privacy" toggle with more details.

flirtual:geolocation_privacy_details.description: Text revealed when the user expands the "Privacy" toggle under the geolocation option, explaining how their location is stored and shown.

flirtual:geolocation_removed.description: Confirmation toast after the user deleted their saved location.

flirtual:geolocation_updated.description: Confirmation toast after the user's device location was saved to their profile settings.

flirtual:get_app.description: Menu item in the profile menu (web only) linking to the download page for the iOS/Android/VR apps. Imperative: get the app.

screens: dialog: Out of likes and passes
flirtual:get_premium.description: Main button of the daily-limit dialog; opens the Premium subscription page. "Premium" is the name of the paid subscription.

flirtual:giant_strong_thrush_startle.description: Explanation on the blocked-profile card, above the Unblock and Report buttons.

flirtual:google.description: Brand name Google, as a sign-in provider. Shown as the small label above the linked Google account's name on its connection button, and in the list of providers in "…instead of {providers}" on the password settings page. Normally left untranslated.

flirtual:google_play.description: Store name on an app download button, under a small uppercase "Download on" line ("DOWNLOAD ON / Google Play"). Official store name; keep it unless Google uses a localized name in your language.

flirtual:gradient.description: Name shown on a brand color swatch: the main pink-orange brand gradient. Sibling swatches are "Dark Mode", "Homie Mode", "Pink" and "Cream".

flirtual:green_aqua_ibex_value.description: Line under "It's a match!" telling the user they and the other person liked each other (also used for mutual Homies). On the web the name is a link to that person's profile.

name.meaning: The other user's display name (self-closing tag replaced by the name)

tags.name: Self-closing tag replaced by the other user's display name, linked to their profile; keep it as <name/>

flirtual:green_plain_mongoose_lend.description: Site description shown in link previews when a Flirtual link is shared on social media and chat apps (Open Graph/Twitter card). Not visible in the app itself. The trailing ellipsis is intentional.

flirtual:gross_each_cobra_talk.description: Warning after a ⚠️ emoji under the user's subscription in the iOS/Android app when the subscription was bought on the website, so it must be managed there.

platform.meaning: Platform of the app the user is using now (translated "iOS" or "Android")

flirtual:gross_known_deer_sprout.description: Instruction in the "Upload pictures" dialog (Uppy upload widget) on the website, where users add profile pictures by dragging files in or clicking the inserted "browse" link.

browseFiles.meaning: Clickable link text that opens the file picker, supplied by the upload widget

flirtual:guidelines.description: Expand toggle under the profile pictures and bio field hints that reveals content rules for that field. Plural noun (content rules).

flirtual:guides.description: Title of the Guides page, which lists informational and tutorial pages (currently only one: mental health resources); also in the browser tab title.

flirtual:happy_whole_parrot_intend.description: Heading of the change-email form on the confirm-email page, below the resend section.

flirtual:hard_cause_trick_puzzling.description: Entire body of the About page: the founders' story, a signature, a P.S., then "The team" and "Timeline" sections whose contents come from other keys. Keep all tags and their nesting. VRLFP, VRChat, Oculus, kfarwell and Tony are proper names; "homies" is slang for friends and echoes the app's friend-finding Homie Mode.

tags.group: Vertical block grouping the logo, signature and Discord link
tags.logo: Self-closing; renders the Flirtual logo image. Keep as <logo/>
tags.discord: Link to Flirtual's Discord server; wraps the link text
tags.contact: Link to the support site, for reporting bugs; wraps the link text
tags.ideas: Opens the feature-suggestion dialog; wraps the link text
tags.team-list: Self-closing; renders the list of team members. Keep as <team-list/>
tags.timeline: Self-closing; renders the year-by-year timeline. Keep as <timeline/>

flirtual:hard_cause_trick_puzzling.tone: Warm, personal, first-person plural from the founders

flirtual:have_fun.description: Toast after saving the Fun stuff settings.

flirtual:heavy_weak_hare_spin.description: Tip revealed under "Tips" on the empty Matches page: what makes the matchmaking show your profile more often, plus an invitation to the Flirtual Discord server. "Like" is the dating swipe action.

tags.discordLink: Link to Flirtual's Discord community server; wraps the link text

flirtual:help.description: Category heading in the mobile settings list above Support, Ideas and Network Status links.

flirtual:help_translate.description: Hint next to the Language selector on the Appearance settings page, shown when the app is in a non-English language, inviting the user to help improve the translation into that language. Currently only visible to staff testers.

language.meaning: Name of the currently selected app language, already translated into that language

tags.translateLink: Link to this language's page on Flirtual's Weblate translation project; wraps the call-to-action word

flirtual:help_translate_others.description: Hint next to the Language selector on the Appearance settings page, shown when the app is in English (the default language), inviting the user to help translate Flirtual into their own language. Currently only visible to staff testers.

tags.translateLink: Link to Flirtual's translation project on Weblate; wraps the call-to-action word

flirtual:helpful_petty_peacock_hunt.description: Onboarding tour step pointing at the Like button. "Like" is the button name (signals romantic interest) and "match" means both people liked each other.

flirtual:heroic_big_firefox_enrich.description: Body of the "Confirm your email" card shown instead of profiles in the browse screen when the user hasn't confirmed their email; followed by a "Confirm email" button. "Hidden" means other users can't see the profile.

flirtual:heroic_pink_gull_breathe.description: Troubleshooting step on the web error dialog/error page: update the browser and device software. The native-app version also mentions the app.

tags.browser-icon: Self-closing browser-window icon placed right before the word for browser; keep it before that word
tags.device-icon: Self-closing phone icon placed right before the word for device; keep it before that word

flirtual:hide.description: Tooltip on the eye icon in password fields while the password is visible; clicking hides the typed characters again. Pairs with "Show".

flirtual:home.description: Bottom tab in the native iOS/Android app for logged-out users, opening the landing page. Next to the "Log in" tab.
flirtual:home.lengthNote: Native bottom tab bar label; keep short

flirtual:home_watery_koala_stop.description: Title of the dialog opened by the Share button on your own profile, where you can change your custom profile link and share or copy it.

flirtual:home_wild_marten_wave.description: Status text with a shield icon in the anti-bot check box (Cloudflare Turnstile) on the login and sign-up forms, after the check passes.
flirtual:home_wild_marten_wave.lengthNote: Single line inside a fixed 300px-wide box

flirtual:homely_living_owe_coach.description: Heading of a banner shown at the top of the subscription page when the user returns from a successful checkout. Followed by a note that the purchase will be applied shortly.

screens: dialog: They're not looking for your gender
flirtual:homie.description: The friend-request swipe action (peace-sign icon), the Homie Mode counterpart of "Like": signals you want to be friends with this person, and a mutual Homie creates a match. Shown as the tooltip of the green peace-sign button and as a button in the "Send a Homie instead?" dialog. Used as a verb-like action label here, but it is the same word as the noun "Homie" (a friend).

flirtual:homie_mode.description: Name of the friend-finding mode of the app (browsing for platonic friends, shown with a green theme), as opposed to the dating mode. Used as a button on the "Out of profiles" card that switches to it, as the browser tab title of /homies, and as the label of the green Homie Mode color swatch on the branding page. "Homie" is slang for a friend; this is a feature name and should match the other Homie strings.
flirtual:homie_mode.resolved: Localize (decided): de Kumpel-Modus, fr Mode Potes, es Modo Amigos, nl Maatjesmodus, pt/pt-BR Modo Amigos, ru Режим друзей, sv Kompisläge, ja 友活モード, ko 친구 모드. See the glossary.

flirtual:homies.description: Tab label in the native iOS/Android app's bottom tab bar (peace-sign icon) for Homie Mode, where users browse profiles to find friends. "Homies" is slang for friends; pairs with the "Dates" tab.
flirtual:homies.lengthNote: Bottom tab bar label with five tabs; keep it to one short word

flirtual:honest_loud_felix_favor.description: Second paragraph of the Date/Homie Mode tour step, explaining free daily limits. "Like/Homie" are the two interest actions (dating vs friendship).

flirtual:hookups.description: Option in the "Looking for" advanced filter (alongside serious dating, casual dating and new friends) for people seeking casual sex.

flirtual:hookups_hint.description: Checkbox option under "I'm open to…" for casual sexual encounters. ERP = erotic roleplay (sexual roleplay in VR); FWB = friends with benefits. The abbreviations are community slang; keep them or use local equivalents.

screens: dialog: Out of likes and passes
flirtual:hours.description: Small unit label above the hours number in a three-box countdown (hours / minutes / seconds) to the daily limit reset. Stands alone as a column header; the number below can be any value including 0 or 1, so use the general plural/unit form.
flirtual:hours.lengthNote: One of three equal-width columns in a narrow dialog

flirtual:huge.description: Name of the largest of seven text-size steps on the Font size slider, shown beside the label while selected. Order: Tiny, Extra small, Small, Default, Large, Extra large, Huge.
flirtual:huge.lengthNote: Short label at the end of a label row

flirtual:i_acknowledge.description: Button the user must press to confirm they've read a warning from Flirtual's moderators before continuing to use the app. First person: the user says "I acknowledge".

flirtual:i_agree.description: Label of the required checkbox on the sign-up form. The line below it continues the sentence: "I agree" + "to the Terms of Service & Privacy Policy and I'm at least 18 years of age" (key pickle_capricious_cemetery_name). Translate both so they read as one sentence.

flirtual:i_am.description: Label above a radio list with the options Dominant, Submissive and Switch (the user's role in the opt-in adult/kink section). The label reads as the start of a sentence the chosen option completes ("I am… Dominant"); the options are separate keys. Only shown when NSFW tags are enabled.

flirtual:icy_stock_herring_burn.description: Message text pre-filled in the device's native share sheet when sharing your own profile link, written from the sharer's point of view; the link is attached separately.

flirtual:ideal_super_skunk_empower.description: Toast shown when a non-Premium user leaves the Appearance page after trying out profile colors: they could preview them, but the colors weren't saved because custom colors require a Premium subscription.

flirtual:ideas.description: Opens a dialog inviting users to suggest and vote on new features in the #ideas channel of Flirtual's Discord. Means feature ideas/suggestions.

flirtual:ideas_dialog_description.description: Two-paragraph body of the Ideas dialog, above a "Join Discord" button. "#ideas" is the literal name of a Discord channel; keep it unchanged.

tags.strong: Bold; wraps the Discord channel name

flirtual:ideas_dialog_title.description: Title of the dialog opened from "Ideas" links in the footer, settings and About page, inviting users to suggest and vote on features in Discord. Meaning feature suggestions.

flirtual:im_interested_in.description: Label above checkboxes of genders in plural (Men, Women, Other genders) in the last onboarding step, titled "I want to meet…"; the user picks which genders they want to be matched with. "Interested in" means romantic/dating interest in those genders.

flirtual:im_open_to.description: Label above a list of checkboxes for what kinds of relationships the user is looking for (serious dating, casual VR dating, hookups, new friends). Sentence start completed by each checkbox option, so the options should read as continuations of it.

flirtual:image_deleted.description: Toast shown to moderators after deleting a user's profile picture from the moderator image toolbar.

flirtual:inactive_subscription.description: Heading of the section on the subscription page showing the user's most recent plan that has ended.

flirtual:inclusive_silly_ibex_succeed.description: Warning toast shown when the user tries to add another interest (predefined or custom) after already having the maximum of 10.

flirtual:inclusive_simple_alligator_zap.description: Name of Flirtual's music/club VRChat world. Used as the image description, as a heading, and as a button label that opens the world's VRChat page.
flirtual:inclusive_simple_alligator_zap.resolved: Keep the VRChat world name in English exactly; the surrounding sentence may explain what it is.

flirtual:info.description: Heading of a section in the mobile settings menu that groups links to the About, Press, Branding and Developers pages (and Updates in the native app). Means general information about Flirtual.

flirtual:instagram.description: Link to Flirtual's Instagram account. Brand name; normally left untranslated.

flirtual:interests.description: Name of the profile section where users pick hobbies/interests: step 3 of the profile setup progress bar, page title, settings menu item, onboarding field label, and a Premium advanced filter label.
flirtual:interests.lengthNote: Progress-bar segment, one of five on desktop

flirtual:ios.description: Apple's mobile operating system name, inserted into the subscription-platform warnings ("…in the iOS app"). A proper noun; normally left as "iOS".

flirtual:its_a_match.description: Celebratory title of the dialog shown when the user and another person both Liked (or both Homied) each other, creating a match. On the watch it's followed by a ❤️ or ✌️ emoji, and it's also the preview line in the watch's message list for a new match with no messages yet.

flirtual:its_time_for_name.description: Tooltip on the time-difference indicator (clock icon) on another user's profile photo, telling their current local time.

flirtual:join_discord.description: Button with the Discord logo in the Ideas dialog that opens the invite to Flirtual's Discord community server.

flirtual:join_group.description: Button that opens Flirtual's VRChat group page in a new tab so the user can join it.

flirtual:jolly_this_crow_hug.description: Status text with a spinner in the anti-bot check box (Cloudflare Turnstile) on the login and sign-up forms while the automatic check runs.
flirtual:jolly_this_crow_hug.lengthNote: Single line inside a fixed 300px-wide box

flirtual:just_loud_orangutan_dash.description: Heading on the Matches page when the user has no matches (and therefore no conversations) yet.

flirtual:just_me.description: Visibility option in privacy dropdowns: the profile info is hidden from everyone except the user themselves.

flirtual:kind_tangy_marten_fear.description: Variant of the upload dialog's drag-or-browse instruction used when extra import sources (cloud services, camera) are offered; their buttons follow the colon. Website only.

browseFiles.meaning: Clickable link text that opens the file picker, supplied by the upload widget

flirtual:kink_compatibility.description: Matchmaking priority slider label, only for users with the adult NSFW feature on: weight given to compatible kink tags. A multiplier is shown on the same line.

flirtual:kinks.description: Label of the kinks picker on the opt-in adult (NSFW) settings page and heading of the kinks advanced filter group. Sexual preferences/fetishes.

flirtual:knotty_direct_mongoose_bend.description: Site description for search engines (HTML meta description), shown under the page title in search results. Not visible in the app itself.
flirtual:knotty_direct_mongoose_bend.lengthNote: Search engines cut off around 150–160 characters

flirtual:known_antsy_gull_savor.description: Hint under the "Profile pictures" field: upload screenshots of your VR avatar (pictures of your avatar, not real-life photos), aim for 3 or more, or skip for now.

game.meaning: Name of the user's favorite VR game/app from their profile

flirtual:language.description: Field label used in two places: on the profile form, for the languages the user speaks (up to 5 can be picked, despite the singular label); and on the Appearance settings page, for the app's display language.

flirtual:languages.description: Heading of the advanced filter group listing spoken languages; users pick which languages people they see should speak. Shown uppercase via CSS.

flirtual:large.description: Name of the 5th of seven text-size steps (just above default) on the Font size slider, shown beside the label while selected. Order: Tiny, Extra small, Small, Default, Large, Extra large, Huge.
flirtual:large.lengthNote: Short label at the end of a label row

flirtual:large_simple_penguin_learn.description: Warning shown only inside the Android app, prefixed with a ⚠️ emoji, in the passkeys section.

flirtual:large_wild_tortoise_sing.description: Disclaimer box shown on legal pages in every language except English, saying the page was machine-translated and that the English text is the binding one. Followed in the same box by a "contact us" sentence.

tags.original: Link to the English version of the same page

flirtual:last_broad_warbler_nail.description: Placeholder in the text field where the user pastes a playlist link. Keep the example URL unchanged.

flirtual:last_large_midge_spur.description: Bold line at the top of a current policy that has already been scheduled to be replaced, linking to the version that will take over.

range.meaning: Period this policy applies, from its start date until it's replaced, a date range already formatted for the locale

tags.otherPolicy: Link to the upcoming version of the same policy

flirtual:last_updated_date.description: Bold line at the top of the Terms of Service or Privacy Policy page that's currently in effect, saying when it last changed.

date.meaning: Date the policy took effect, already formatted for the locale in long style

flirtual:late_full_rat_stab.description: Description under the "Customize your profile colors" benefit heading, shown to non-subscribers; the color scheme applies to the user's profile as other people see it. Followed by a space and the link "(Check this out for free)".

flirtual:leaked_password_banner.description: Dismissible banner across the top of the app when the user's password appears in a known data breach from another service (Flirtual itself wasn't breached).

tags.bannerLink: Link to the password settings page; wraps the call to action

flirtual:learn_more.description: Generic "read more" link. On the privacy settings page it sits under the analytics opt-out toggle and links to the Privacy Policy; elsewhere it follows a short definition inside a tooltip (e.g. explaining a gender or sexuality term) and links to an external page with more detail.

flirtual:legacy_user_id.description: Item in the Copy submenu of the moderator/admin profile dropdown that copies the user's older-format ID (used by the chat system) to the clipboard.

flirtual:legal.description: Category heading in the mobile settings list above links to the Community Guidelines, Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

flirtual:legal_big_finch_kiss.description: Alt text for a screenshot of an example Flirtual profile on the homepage's avatar section.

flirtual:legal_such_sloth_type.description: Caption in the light-background half of the live preview card next to the profile color picker, above sample interest tags drawn in the chosen colors. Addresses the user.

flirtual:lemon_lime.description: Name of a preset profile color gradient (bright yellow to lime green). Creative name; adapt freely to fit the colors.
flirtual:lemon_lime.lengthNote: Maintainer: keep within ~15 characters so it fits above the swatch

flirtual:less_drab_larva_assure.description: Explanation above the Deactivate account button describing what deactivation does. "Matchmaking" means being shown to others in the browse queue.

flirtual:level_nice_cheetah_drum.description: Warning toast when the user tries to add a passkey but this device/password manager already holds a passkey for their Flirtual account.

flirtual:level_orange_stingray_fulfill.description: Last-message preview in the Matches/conversation list when the current user sent the last message, prefixed with "You:" to show who wrote it. The line is truncated to one line.

message.meaning: Text of the last chat message the current user sent

flirtual:lifetime.description: Shown under the price on the Lifetime plan card, a one-time purchase that gives Premium forever (e.g. "$129.99" then "lifetime"). Lowercase in English, like "monthly".

flirtual:light.description: Light color theme, an option in the small theme dropdown in the page footer and on login/sign-up cards (with Dark and System). Adjective for the theme, not light as in weight.

flirtual:light_flat_racoon_buzz.description: Onboarding tour step pointing at the Homie button in Homie Mode. "Like" and "Homie" are button names (dating interest vs friendship interest), also used as verbs.

flirtual:light_theme.description: Tooltip on the screenshot button that switches the app to its light color theme.

flirtual:light_theme_image.description: Not text: the ID of the uploaded screenshot image shown for the Light theme option. Copy it exactly, unchanged.
flirtual:light_theme_image.resolved: Media ID, not text: copy unchanged. Read-only in Weblate.

flirtual:light_theme_preview.description: Screen-reader alt text for the screenshot showing the app in light theme, on the theme selection button.

flirtual:light_wacky_tadpole_enrich.description: Banner on the subscription page in the Apple Vision Pro app, for users without Premium; purchases can't be made there. "Apple Vision" is Apple's headset product name.

flirtual:like.description: The browse action that signals romantic interest in a profile (if both people Like each other, it's a match), not the general verb "to like". Tooltip on the heart button next to its keyboard shortcut, and the VoiceOver label of the heart button on the Apple Watch. Pairs with "Homie" (friend interest) and "Pass".

flirtual:likes_you.description: Title of the Premium "Likes You" page, a list of people who have Liked or Homied the user. A feature/page name: "people who like you", not a sentence about one person.

flirtual:lime_soft_shad_skip.description: Intro paragraph of the public branding page, which offers Flirtual's logos and colors for download. "Our art" means the brand assets.

tags.contact: Email link to Flirtual's press address; wraps the link text

flirtual:linked_connection.description: Confirmation toast after the user successfully links an external account (Discord, Apple, Google, etc.) to their Flirtual account.

flirtual:location.description: Label of the matchmaking-priority slider for physical distance (prefer people nearby vs. farther away). The hint text above the sliders refers to it as "Location" in quotes, so keep both the same.

flirtual:log_in.description: Verb phrase for signing in to an existing account: login page heading, login form submit button, homepage call-to-action, and the logged-out bottom tab in the native app.
flirtual:log_in.lengthNote: Also a native bottom tab bar label; keep short

flirtual:logging_in.description: Status text under a spinner while the user is being logged in automatically from a one-click login link (e.g. from an email).

flirtual:login.description: Used as the login page's browser tab title, and as the button back to login after requesting or completing a password reset. Separate from "Log in" (the verb on the login button); here it works as a noun/page name.

flirtual:logout.description: Action in the settings list (under "Account") that signs the user out immediately. Use the imperative verb form "Log out"/"Sign out" common in your language.

flirtual:looking_for.description: Category heading in the advanced filter tag picker, grouping relationship goals: serious dating, casual dating, hookups, new friends (Premium-only category).

flirtual:loose_fancy_marlin_zip.description: Confirmation toast after the user taps something that copies text (a username, link, ID) to the clipboard. Not shown on Android 13+, where the system confirms copies itself.

flirtual:lost_sour_moose_tend.description: Moderator-only toolbar text after "Uploaded …", saying which VRChat user took the photo and in which VRChat world (from the photo's metadata).

tags.name: Self-closing; replaced by a link with the photographer's VRChat name to their VRChat profile
tags.world: Self-closing; replaced by a link with the VRChat world name to that world's page

flirtual:lost_spare_millipede_nurture.description: Note on the subscription page for users with an active subscription. "Manage" in quotes is the label of the button on the same page; it must match the translation of that button (key "manage").

flirtual:loved_many_raven_pout.description: Sentence appended (after a space) to the paragraph explaining why Premium exists, shown to users who have never had a subscription or purchase.

flirtual:low_slow_platypus_taste.description: Secondary link under the Deactivate/Reactivate button that goes to the permanent account deletion page instead.

flirtual:main_civil_jaguar_peel.description: Gray italic hint shown after saving a playlist link, above where the embedded playlist should appear.

tags.strong: Bold emphasis on the required link type

flirtual:main_large_goat_succeed.description: Last paragraph on the dating "Out of profiles" card, suggesting the user switch to Homie Mode (friend-finding) to keep browsing.

tags.browseLink: Link to Homie Mode browsing (/homies); wraps the feature name "Homie Mode"

screens: dialog: They're not looking for your gender
flirtual:major_soft_puffin_offer.description: Body text of the same dialog, offering to send a friend request (a "Homie") instead of a Like. Followed by two buttons: "Pass" and "Homie". "Homie" here is the friend-request action, as a noun.

flirtual:major_vivid_beetle_support.description: Generic error in the anti-bot check box on login and sign-up when the automatic device check fails. Followed by a small error code; tapping retries.
flirtual:major_vivid_beetle_support.lengthNote: Shares one line with an error code inside a fixed 300px-wide box

flirtual:manage.description: Small button on the user's current plan (in the plan list and under their subscription status). It opens subscription management: the payment provider's portal on the web, or the App Store/Google Play subscription settings. Referenced in quotes by other sentences on the page, so keep them consistent.

flirtual:manage_subscription.description: Small secondary button under the Premium renewal warning on the reactivate-account page; opens the subscription management/purchase flow so the user can cancel or change their Premium subscription.

flirtual:many_direct_chipmunk_sew.description: Premium benefit, prefixed by a 👀 emoji. For subscribers it is a link to the Likes page; for non-subscribers it is a bold heading followed by a longer description. "Likes" is capitalized because it is the app's Like action (signalling romantic/friendship interest in a profile), not the general verb.

flirtual:many_top_quail_embrace.description: Premium benefit, prefixed by a 💃 emoji. For subscribers it links to the appearance settings, where they choose their profile's color theme; for non-subscribers it is a bold heading followed by a description.

flirtual:mark_all_as_read.description: Button above the conversation list that marks every unread conversation as read. Shown only when there are unread chats.

flirtual:mark_only.description: Section heading on the branding page above logo files that contain only the logo symbol (the "mark"), without the "Flirtual" wordmark text. Use the usual design term for a logo symbol/icon without text.

flirtual:maroon_polite_butterfly_boil.description: Text under "One more step" telling the user a confirmation link was emailed to them. Followed by a "Send again" button.

tags.copy: Shows the email address in bold; clicking it copies it to the clipboard. Keep {email} inside it

flirtual:match_notifications.description: Row label in the notification settings grid, followed by an email checkbox and a push checkbox. Controls notifications when the user gets a new match (two people liked each other).
flirtual:match_notifications.lengthNote: Row label in a fixed-height grid row beside two checkboxes; should fit on one line on a phone

flirtual:matches.description: Name of the Matches section, the list of conversations with people the user matched with (both liked each other). Used as the native app's bottom tab label, the Matches page heading and tab title, a button on the Likes You page, and the Apple Watch's conversations screen title. Plural noun.
flirtual:matches.lengthNote: Native bottom tab bar label; keep short

flirtual:matches_only.description: Visibility option in privacy dropdowns: only people the user has matched with (mutual likes) can see this profile info.

flirtual:matching_images.description: Title of the moderator-only dialog listing profiles with pictures that match the searched image (internal image search).

flirtual:matchmaking.description: Name of the settings page for who the user is matched with (genders, ages, filters, priorities): settings menu item, page heading, and browser tab title via "{name} - Flirtual".

flirtual:matchmaking_priorities.description: Heading (with a Premium badge) of the section of sliders that set how much weight each factor gets when ranking who the user sees.

flirtual:mealy_lime_mayfly_support.description: First line of the final onboarding tour step's note, which reads like a short letter: this line, a reminder to drink water, "<3", then the signature "The Flirtual Team".

flirtual:mean_such_flamingo_drop.description: Title of the onboarding tour step pointing at the Undo button.

flirtual:mellow_short_shark_propel.description: Alt text for the still image behind the homepage's background video, which shows people on dates in VR. "Dates" is a noun: dates that happen through Flirtual.

flirtual:mental_health.description: Used only in the browser tab title of the mental health resources page ("Mental health - Flirtual").

flirtual:mental_health_resources.description: Title of the page listing crisis hotlines and peer-support communities; also the link to it on the Guides page.

flirtual:merry_arable_alligator_coax.description: Confirmation toast after saving the Connections settings form (linked accounts such as VRChat username, and the music playlist).

flirtual:merry_smart_snake_boil.description: Confirmation toast after the user saves their notification settings.

flirtual:message.description: On a matched user's profile, the button that opens the chat with them (action: send them a message). On the Apple Watch it's also the button that opens a text field to message a new match, and the placeholder of the reply field in a conversation, so a word that works both as the action and as a field placeholder is best.
flirtual:message.lengthNote: Small button; on the watch, shown next to an icon on a tiny screen

flirtual:message_acknowledged.description: Confirmation toast after the user pressed "I acknowledge" on a moderator's warning message.

flirtual:message_notifications.description: Row label in the notification settings grid, followed by an email checkbox and a push checkbox. Controls notifications for new chat messages from matches.
flirtual:message_notifications.lengthNote: Row label in a fixed-height grid row beside two checkboxes; should fit on one line on a phone

flirtual:meta.description: Brand name Meta (the company behind Quest VR headsets), as a linked account. Shown as the small label above the linked Meta account's name on its connection button, and in the list of providers on the password settings page. Normally left untranslated.

flirtual:meta_username.description: Line next to a Meta icon on a profile (visible to matches and on your own profile) showing the person's linked Meta account name, followed by a copy button and a verified badge.

name.meaning: The user's Meta account display name

tags.copy: Wraps the name; links to their Meta profile

flirtual:meta_verified.description: Tooltip on a checkmark badge next to a profile's Meta (Quest) account name, meaning the Meta account is linked to Flirtual.

flirtual:microsoft_store.description: Store name on an app download button, under a small uppercase "Download on" line. Official store name; use Microsoft's localized name for its store if one exists in your language.

flirtual:minor_gaudy_seal_ask.description: Title of the onboarding tour step pointing at the switch between Date Mode and Homie Mode.

flirtual:mint_colossal_kettle_sense.description: Banner with a heart or peace-sign icon on a profile, shown only to Premium users, saying this person already sent them a Like ("liked", dating interest) or a Homie ("homied", friendship interest).

status.meaning: ICU select: liked, or other (homied); keep the keys untranslated

flirtual:minty_fresh.description: Name of a preset profile color gradient (bright mint green to cyan), shown above a gradient swatch the user can click. Creative name; adapt freely to fit the colors.
flirtual:minty_fresh.lengthNote: Maintainer: keep within ~15 characters so it fits above the swatch

screens: dialog: Out of likes and passes
flirtual:minutes.description: Small unit label above the minutes number in a three-box countdown (hours / minutes / seconds) to the daily limit reset. Stands alone as a column header; the number below can be any value, so use the general plural/unit form.
flirtual:minutes.lengthNote: One of three equal-width columns in a narrow dialog

flirtual:mobile_notifications.description: Tooltip on the phone icon heading the push notification column of the notification settings grid; the checkboxes below it turn each push notification type on or off in the mobile app.

flirtual:mod_queue.description: Staff-only link (moderators) to the moderation queue, where reported or flagged profiles wait for review. Appears in the profile dropdown menu and in a "Staff" section of the settings list.

flirtual:monogamous.description: Relationship style (one partner at a time). Shown as a tag on profiles, an option in the Relationship type advanced filter, and as a matchmaking-priority slider label for monogamous users.

flirtual:monthly.description: Billing period shown on its own line under the price on the monthly plan card (e.g. "$14.99" then "monthly"). Lowercase in English; siblings are "every 3 months", "every 6 months" and "lifetime".

flirtual:more_about_you.description: Title of the second onboarding step (and browser tab title), where the user picks VR apps/games and interests. Follows the "About you" step.

flirtual:more_details.description: Title of step 2 of profile setup (relationship goals, sexuality, relationship type, etc.), also used as the browser tab title.

flirtual:more_info.description: Expand toggle in the expanded-search banner that reveals a longer explanation below it.

flirtual:motionless_absorbed_scintillati.description: One of three sentences (this is 1 of 3) that rotate every 5 seconds below the heading "Your avatar, your choice" on the homepage, explaining why meeting through VR avatars is appealing.
flirtual:motionless_absorbed_scintillati.lengthNote: Shown in a fixed-height box in large text; keep about the same length as the English

flirtual:motionless_absorbed_scintillati.description: One of three sentences (this is 2 of 3) that rotate every 5 seconds below the heading "Your avatar, your choice" on the homepage, explaining why meeting through VR avatars is appealing.
flirtual:motionless_absorbed_scintillati.lengthNote: Shown in a fixed-height box in large text; keep about the same length as the English

flirtual:motionless_absorbed_scintillati.description: One of three sentences (this is 3 of 3) that rotate every 5 seconds below the heading "Your avatar, your choice" on the homepage, explaining why meeting through VR avatars is appealing.
flirtual:motionless_absorbed_scintillati.lengthNote: Shown in a fixed-height box in large text; keep about the same length as the English

screens: dialog: They're not looking for your gender
flirtual:moving_petty_racoon_intend.description: Title of a dialog that opens when the user presses Like on a profile (reached from Homie Mode or a direct profile link) whose owner isn't interested in the user's gender, so Like is disabled. "They" is the other user; "your gender" is the current user's gender.

flirtual:mushy_sound_nils_fetch.description: Onboarding tour step pointing at the matches/conversations button. VRChat is a product name.

flirtual:my_gender.description: Label above the gender checkboxes in the first onboarding step, where the new user picks their own gender(s) (Man, Woman, Other genders…). Refers to the user's own gender.

flirtual:need_help.description: On login/sign-up and other minimal pages it is a footer link with an info icon that opens the support chat. On the delete-account form (when the reason "Technical issues" is selected) it is followed by a separate "Contact us" link and a period.

flirtual:network_status.description: Link to Flirtual's external service status page (status.flirtual.net), which shows whether the servers are up or having an outage. Also shown on the maintenance/connection-error screen.

flirtual:new.description: Small badge marking a recently added feature, next to settings menu items and option labels. Displayed in uppercase via CSS.
flirtual:new.lengthNote: Tiny pill badge; keep very short

flirtual:new_email_address.description: Label of the field for entering the new email address when changing it.

flirtual:new_friends.description: Checkbox option under "I'm open to…" meaning platonic friendship, and an option in the Premium advanced "Looking for" filter. Read as a continuation of "I'm open to…".

flirtual:new_password.description: Label of the password field when changing an existing password, and on the reset-password page after following a forgot-password email link.

flirtual:news.2023_apps_themes.body.description: Body of the October 2023 announcement "New iPhone & Android apps, profile themes, and more". The final paragraph after the footer advertises a recurring DJ Night community event.

Shown as the title of the news dialog (which pops up once for logged-in users who haven't seen it) and as a clickable entry title in the list on the public Updates page (/news).

Shown as the title of the news dialog (which pops up once for logged-in users who haven't seen it) and as a clickable entry title in the list on the public Updates page (/news).

"100k" means 100,000. Shown as the title of the news dialog (which pops up once for logged-in users who haven't seen it) and as a clickable entry title in the list on the public Updates page (/news).

Homies Day is Flirtual's friendship-themed spin on Valentine's Day; Homie Mode is browsing for friends. "Flirtulore" is a pun on Flirtual + lore. "Meta Quest app" refers to Flirtual's app on Meta Quest headsets.

flirtual:news.2024_homies_day.title.description: Title of the February 14, 2024 announcement. "Homies Day" is Flirtual's friendship-themed take on Valentine's Day ("homies" = friends; Homie Mode is the app's friend-finding mode). Shown as the title of the news dialog (which pops up once for logged-in users who haven't seen it) and as a clickable entry title in the list on the public Updates page (/news).

flirtual:news.2024_wrapped.title.description: Title of the New Year 2025 announcement recapping Flirtual in 2024. "Wrapped" refers to a year-in-review recap (as in Spotify Wrapped); keep "Flirtual" and the year. Shown as the title of the news dialog (which pops up once for logged-in users who haven't seen it) and as a clickable entry title in the list on the public Updates page (/news).

flirtual:news.2025_catch_up.body.description: Body of the December 2025 news item "New-ish profile tags!", shown to existing users after login. The <form /> placeholder is replaced by an "I'm open to" checklist (serious dating, casual dating, hookups, new friends) with a Save button; "relationship tags" refers to those options.

tags.form: Self-closing; replaced by the relationship-tag checklist form. Keep in place.
tags.bio: Link to Bio & Pics Settings (/settings/bio), where profile prompts are answered
tags.connections: Link to Connections Settings (/settings/connections), where a music playlist can be added

flirtual:news.2025_catch_up.title.description: Title of a December 2025 catch-up announcement re-introducing the relationship tags (what you're looking for) that were added a while earlier. "New-ish" is a joke that they're only somewhat new. Shown as the title of the news dialog (which pops up once for logged-in users who haven't seen it); this item isn't listed on the public Updates page.

flirtual:news.2025_location.body.description: Intro sentence of the December 2025 news item "Location, location, location", shown to existing users after login. The <form /> placeholder is replaced by an inline form (distance-matchmaking switch, timezone picker, location priority slider and Save button).

tags.form: Self-closing; replaced by the location/timezone settings form. Keep in place.

flirtual:news.2025_location.location_pri.description: Label above a slider in the location news item's form. The slider sets how much weight matchmaking gives to how close people are; a multiplier value (e.g. "1×") is shown to the right of the label.

Hint text under the "Location priority" slider label. Right means higher priority on nearby people; left means lower. If the UI is mirrored in right-to-left languages, the directions may need to flip.

flirtual:news.2025_location.title.description: Title of the December 2025 announcement that users can add their location and timezone to their profile. Plays on the English real-estate saying "location, location, location"; a natural equivalent or a simple title about location is fine. Shown as the title of the news dialog (which pops up once for logged-in users who haven't seen it); this item isn't listed on the public Updates page.

flirtual:news.2025_wrapped.body.description: Body of the "Flirtual Wrapped 2025" New Year announcement (January 2026), with a year-in-review map image, recent small features and a 2026 roadmap. VRChat and VRCX are product names; VRCX is a third-party VRChat companion app.

tags.image-wrapped: Self-closing; replaced by the Wrapped 2025 map image (click to enlarge). Keep in place.
tags.footer: Self-closing; replaced by the standard news footer (news.footer). Keep in place.

flirtual:news.2025_wrapped.title.description: Title of the New Year 2026 announcement with a map of matches made around the world in 2025 and a recap of the year. "Wrapped" refers to a year-in-review recap (as in Spotify Wrapped); keep "Flirtual" and the year. Shown as the title of the news dialog (which pops up once for logged-in users who haven't seen it) and as a clickable entry title in the list on the public Updates page (/news).

flirtual:news.2026_matchmaking.body.description: Body of the July 2026 announcement "Matchmaking upgrade: Homie Mode, distance, and filters", shown once in a pop-up dialog after login and kept on the /news page. Date Mode is browsing for dating; Homie Mode is browsing for friends. "Like" is the dating interest action and "Homie" (also used as a verb, "Homie someone") is the friendship interest action; both are product terms. "strat" is gaming slang for strategy.

tags.likes: Link to the Likes You page (/likes)
tags.footer: Self-closing; replaced by the standard news footer (news.footer). Keep in place.

flirtual:news.2026_matchmaking.title.description: Title of the July 2026 announcement about matchmaking changes. "Homie Mode" is the product name of the friend-finding mode (vs. Date Mode); "distance" means distance-based matchmaking and "filters" are the new advanced matchmaking filters. Shown as the title of the news dialog (which pops up once for logged-in users who haven't seen it) and as a clickable entry title in the list on the public Updates page (/news).

flirtual:news.footer.description:
Standard closing block inserted at the
spot of most news/update announcements in the News dialog. Each

is a separate paragraph starting with an emoji.

tags.ideas: Button that opens the feature ideas dialog (suggest and vote on features)
tags.contact: Link to the Flirtual support/contact site
tags.github: Link to Flirtual's open-source GitHub repository
tags.discord: Link to the Flirtual Discord server
tags.vrchat: Link to the Flirtual VRChat group

flirtual:newsroom.description: Section heading on the Press page above a list of news articles written about Flirtual (links to external press coverage).

flirtual:next.description: "Next" in the sense of go forward: the button that moves to the next announcement when the news dialog has several, and the accessible label (screen readers only) of the right-hand tap area that shows the next photo on a profile.

flirtual:nice_wise_ibex_accept.description: Title of the onboarding tour step pointing at the profile/settings menu button.

flirtual:nimble_equal_loris_foster.description: Text under "Upcoming events". "Speed matching" events are Flirtual's speed-dating-style rounds in VRChat; DJ events are virtual music parties.

flirtual:nimble_hour_bumblebee_savor.description: Label of a yes/no switch where users mark themselves as new to VR, addressed to the user.

flirtual:no.description: Right half of the app's Yes/No toggle switch used for many on/off settings, and the button in the "unsaved settings" dialog that continues without saving.
flirtual:no.lengthNote: Half of a compact two-option toggle; keep short

flirtual:no_likes_yet.description: Heading on the Likes You page when nobody has liked the user yet.

flirtual:no_likes_yet_description.description: Line under "No one has liked you yet" on the empty Likes You page, reassuring the user that likes will come.

flirtual:no_likes_yet_description_filter.description: Line under the filtered empty-state heading on the Likes You page, suggesting changing the list filters or waiting.

flirtual:no_likes_yet_filters.description: Heading on the Likes You page when filters (kind: date/homie, or gender) are applied and no one matching them has liked the user.

flirtual:no_results.description: Empty-state message in the moderator image search dialog when no matching images were found.

flirtual:no_world_profiles_description.description: Empty-state message in the "Photos from world" dialog when no other user has a profile picture taken in that VRChat world.

flirtual:noble_cute_lionfish_thrive.description: Body of the reset-passes confirmation dialog, warning that every profile the user skipped (passed on) will be un-skipped and that this can't be reverted. "Passed on" means swiped away / skipped in browsing.

flirtual:nonmonogamous.description: Relationship style open to multiple partners (polyamory, open relationships). Shown as a tag on profiles, an option in the Relationship type advanced filter, and as a matchmaking-priority slider label for non-monogamous users.

flirtual:not_now.description: Secondary button that closes the update dialog without updating.
flirtual:not_now.lengthNote: Shares a row with the Update/Refresh button in a narrow dialog

flirtual:note_deleted.description: Toast shown to moderators after deleting the internal moderator note on a user's profile.

flirtual:note_updated.description: Toast shown to moderators after saving the internal moderator note on a user's profile.

flirtual:notifications.description: Name of the notification settings page: the settings menu item (next to a bell icon), the page heading, and the browser tab title via "{name} - Flirtual". Refers to email and push notifications from the app.

flirtual:nsfw.description: Name of the settings page for the opt-in adult content features (kinks, dom/sub role); used as the settings menu item, page heading and tab title. "NSFW" (not safe for work) is internet slang; use the common local equivalent or keep the abbreviation.

flirtual:nsfw_privacy.description: Label of a dropdown choosing who can see the user's NSFW (adult kink) tags: anyone on Flirtual, matches only, or just me. Only shown to users who enabled the NSFW feature.

flirtual:nsfw_privacy_hint.description: Question shown as a hint next to the "NSFW privacy" label, above the who-can-see dropdown. NSFW tags are the user's adult kink tags.

flirtual:number_multiplier.description: Multiplier readout at the right of each matchmaking priority slider label, showing the slider's current weight (turns red at 0).

flirtual:number_plus.description: Age range readout next to the "Age range" slider when the upper handle is at the maximum (60), meaning this age or older.

flirtual:number_range.description: Age range readout next to the "Age range" slider, showing the selected minimum and maximum ages.

flirtual:number_range_plus.description: Age range readout next to the "Age range" slider when the full range is selected: from the minimum age to the maximum and anyone older.

to.meaning: Highest slider value; ages above it are included

flirtual:nutritious_challenge_blue_end.description: Banner across the top of the app when the user hasn't finished setting up their profile, so others can't see them yet.

tags.bannerLink: Link to the next profile-setup step; wraps the call to action

flirtual:odd_blue_clownfish_gleam.description: Placeholder in the delete-account comment box when the reason is "I've found a relationship on Flirtual"; invites the user to share their success story (couple who met on the app).

flirtual:odd_mad_dog_nurture.description: Toast confirming you changed your custom profile link (URL) in the share dialog.

flirtual:ok_gross_ostrich_work.description: Hint beside the "Attachments" label in the report dialog, above the image upload area. "Off-platform behavior" means conduct outside Flirtual, e.g. in VRChat or Discord.

flirtual:onboarding_interests_hint.description: Hint under the "Interests" label in the second onboarding step, where the user picks up to 10 interests from a short list; reassures them they can add more on their profile later.

flirtual:one_more_step.description: Heading on the confirm-email page, shown after sign-up until the user confirms their email address (or adds one).

flirtual:open_google_play.description: Button on the Android age-check card that opens the Google Play Store so the user can verify their age there.

flirtual:open_minded.description: Personality tag pill on a profile, derived from the personality questions: high openness (opposite of "Practical"). Also on the Apple Watch.

flirtual:optional.description: Hint shown next to a form field label to say filling it in isn't required (e.g. next to "Custom interests", "Country", "Timezone").

flirtual:or.description: Single word centered on a horizontal divider line, separating the email/password form from the "Continue with Google/Apple/Discord" buttons. Standalone; not part of a sentence.

flirtual:or_log_in.description: Secondary link-button next to the main submit button (Continue on /forgot, Create account on /sign-up) that goes to the login page instead, with an arrow icon. Lowercase "or" because it reads as an alternative to the main button.
flirtual:or_log_in.lengthNote: Small button beside the main one

flirtual:or_sign_up.description: Secondary link-button next to the Log in button that goes to the account creation page instead, with an arrow icon. Lowercase "or" because it reads as an alternative to logging in.
flirtual:or_sign_up.lengthNote: Small button beside the Log in button

flirtual:ornate_upper_guppy_mend.description: Text under "Need more?" on the branding page, above a Download button for the press kit (a ZIP file).

flirtual:other_genders.description: Checkbox option used in two places: in the user's own gender selection (after e.g. Man/Woman), where ticking it opens a search box with more gender identities; and in the "I want to meet…" list (after plurals like Men/Women) meaning people of any other gender. Must work both as a self-description choice and as a group of people to meet.

flirtual:our_logo.description: Section heading on the branding page above the full Flirtual logo files (PNG/SVG in several color variants).

flirtual:out_of_profiles.description: Title of the card shown in the browse screen when the user has seen every available profile (in dating or Homie Mode).

flirtual:outgoing_teeny_tiny_pass_male.2.description: Timeline entry text for 2018 on the About page, next to a screenshot. Refers to VRLFP, Flirtual's original name, launching.
Accessible description of the 2018 screenshot of the app in the About page timeline.
Year heading of a timeline entry on the About page. Emojis sit on the side away from the image (entries alternate left/right), so keep the emoji's position.

Year heading of a timeline entry on the About page. Emojis sit on the side away from the image (entries alternate left/right), so keep the emoji's position.
Timeline entry text for 2020, about early experimental design concepts. "Let us cook" is slang for letting someone experiment freely; use a natural equivalent.
Accessible description of the 2020 image of the app in the About page timeline.
Year heading of a timeline entry on the About page. Emojis sit on the side away from the image (entries alternate left/right), so keep the emoji's position.
Timeline entry text for 2021. ROVR is the proper name of a former companion app; Homie Mode is Flirtual's friend-finding mode (translate consistently with that feature name).
Accessible description of the 2021 image of the app in the About page timeline.
Year heading of a timeline entry on the About page. Emojis sit on the side away from the image (entries alternate left/right), so keep the emoji's position.
Timeline entry text for 2022, when the app was renamed from VRLFP to Flirtual. The second sentence jokes that the old acronym was hard to spell.
Accessible description of the 2022 screenshot of the app in the About page timeline.
Year heading of a timeline entry on the About page. Emojis sit on the side away from the image (entries alternate left/right), so keep the emoji's position.
Timeline entry text for 2023, when the app was rebuilt and iOS/Android apps launched.
Accessible description of the 2023 screenshot of the app in the About page timeline.
Year heading of a timeline entry on the About page. Emojis sit on the side away from the image (entries alternate left/right), so keep the emoji's position.
Timeline entry text for 2024, listing new profile features. "Interests" are the interest tags users add to their profiles; "profile prompts" are question-and-answer sections on profiles.
Accessible description of the 2024 screenshot of the app in the About page timeline.
Year heading of a timeline entry on the About page. Emojis sit on the side away from the image (entries alternate left/right), so keep the emoji's position.
Timeline entry text for 2025, about performance, stability and safety work.
Accessible description of the 2025 screenshot of the app in the About page timeline.
Year heading of a timeline entry on the About page. Emojis sit on the side away from the image (entries alternate left/right), so keep the emoji's position.

flirtual:page_title.description: Title shown in the web browser's tab/window, built from the name of the current page and the brand, e.g. "Matches - Flirtual". Only change the separator if your language uses a different hyphen/dash character in this context.

name.meaning: Name of the current page (another translated string)

flirtual:pass.description: The browse action to skip a profile (not interested), as on dating apps; not "pass" as in a ticket or to succeed. Tooltip on the X button, a button in the "Send a Homie instead?" dialog, and the VoiceOver label of the X button on the Apple Watch.

flirtual:passes_reset.description: Toast after the user confirms resetting passes: every profile they previously skipped ("passed" on) can appear again. "Passes" is the plural noun of the swipe-left/skip action, not a ticket or a password.

flirtual:passkey.description: Fallback name shown for a passkey in the passkey list when its password manager/device can't be identified (otherwise the product name like "iCloud Keychain" is shown).

flirtual:passkeys.description: Heading of the passkeys section (WebAuthn/FIDO passwordless login). Use the term your platform (Apple/Google/Microsoft) uses for passkeys in this language.

flirtual:password.description: Label of the password field on the login and sign-up forms, and on the password settings page when the user has no password yet (e.g. signed up with Apple/Google).

flirtual:password_changed.description: Toast after a user who already had a password successfully changes it.

flirtual:password_passkeys.description: Name of the login security page: the settings menu item (next to a key icon), the page heading, and the browser tab title via "{name} - Flirtual". "Passkeys" are the WebAuthn/FIDO passwordless login credentials.

flirtual:password_set.description: Toast after a user who signed up with a third-party login (Discord, Google, etc.) and had no password sets one for the first time.

flirtual:patchy_warm_mule_play.description: Caption in the dark-background half of the live preview card next to the profile color picker, above sample interest tags drawn in the chosen colors. Addresses the user.

flirtual:patient_proof_octopus_revive.description: In the iOS/Android app, the only text in the profile picture upload dialog's drop area; tapping opens the photo picker. Replaces the website's drag-or-browse instruction.

flirtual:payment_terms.description: Name of the Payment Terms legal page: its page heading and browser tab title. The Terms of Service link to this page with the same name, so keep the wording consistent.

flirtual:payment_terms_and_refund_policy.description: Centered link at the bottom of the subscription page to the legal Payment Terms and Refund Policy page. Use the same title as that legal document.

flirtual:peachy_petal.description: Name of a preset profile color gradient (peach to pink), shown above a gradient swatch the user can click. Creative name; adapt freely to fit the colors.
flirtual:peachy_petal.lengthNote: Maintainer: keep within ~15 characters so it fits above the swatch

flirtual:people_who_have_liked_you.description: Matchmaking priority slider label: weight given to showing people who already liked the user's profile. A multiplier is shown on the same line.

flirtual:personality.description: Name of the personality questionnaire section: page heading, settings menu item, browser tab title, a profile-setup progress step, and the heading of the personality-trait advanced filter group.

flirtual:personality_freespirited.description: Tag option under the Personality category of the advanced filters: people whose personality quiz shows low conscientiousness (spontaneous). Same trait as the "Free-spirited" profile pill; translate consistently. Describes other people of any gender.

flirtual:personality_friendly.description: Tag option under the Personality category of the advanced filters: people whose personality quiz shows high agreeableness. Same trait as the "Friendly" profile pill; translate consistently. Describes other people of any gender.

flirtual:personality_match.description: Matchmaking priority slider label: weight given to how compatible the two people's personality quiz results are. A multiplier is shown on the same line.

flirtual:personality_openminded.description: Tag option under the Personality category of the advanced filters: people whose personality quiz shows high openness. Same trait as the "Open-minded" profile pill; translate consistently. Describes other people of any gender.

flirtual:personality_practical.description: Tag option under the Personality category of the advanced filters: people whose personality quiz shows low openness (down-to-earth). Same trait as the "Practical" profile pill; translate consistently. Describes other people of any gender.

flirtual:personality_privacy.description: Label of a dropdown choosing who can see the user's personality traits (from the personality quiz): anyone on Flirtual, matches only, or just me.

flirtual:personality_privacy_hint.description: Question shown as a hint next to the "Personality privacy" label, above the who-can-see dropdown.

flirtual:personality_questions.0.description: Personality statement the user answers with a Yes/No toggle (they can leave it unanswered). Written in first person as the user describing themselves; keep it a statement, not a question.

flirtual:personality_questions.1.description: Personality statement the user answers with a Yes/No toggle (they can leave it unanswered). First person, about the user's appreciation of beauty; keep it a statement.

flirtual:personality_questions.2.description: Personality statement the user answers with a Yes/No toggle (they can leave it unanswered). First person; keep it a statement.

flirtual:personality_questions.3.description: Personality statement the user answers with a Yes/No toggle (they can leave it unanswered). First person, about planning ahead; keep it a statement.

flirtual:personality_questions.4.description: Personality statement the user answers with a Yes/No toggle (they can leave it unanswered). An opinion the user agrees or disagrees with; keep it a statement.

flirtual:personality_questions.5.description: Personality statement the user answers with a Yes/No toggle (they can leave it unanswered). First person; keep it a statement.

flirtual:personality_questions.6.description: Personality statement the user answers with a Yes/No toggle (they can leave it unanswered). An opinion about human nature the user agrees or disagrees with; keep it a statement.

flirtual:personality_questions.7.description: Personality statement the user answers with a Yes/No toggle (they can leave it unanswered). First person; keep it a statement.

flirtual:personality_questions.8.description: Personality statement the user answers with a Yes/No toggle (they can leave it unanswered). An opinion (honesty vs. sparing feelings) the user agrees or disagrees with; keep it a statement.

flirtual:personality_reliable.description: Tag option under the Personality category of the advanced filters: people whose personality quiz shows high conscientiousness. Same trait as the "Reliable" profile pill; translate consistently. Describes other people of any gender.

flirtual:personality_straightforward.description: Tag option under the Personality category of the advanced filters: people whose personality quiz shows low agreeableness (direct, blunt). Same trait as the "Straightforward" profile pill; translate consistently. Describes other people of any gender.

flirtual:photos_from_world.description: Title of a Premium dialog listing other users' profile pictures taken in the same VRChat world, used when the world's name is unknown. Opened from the world badge on an expanded profile picture.

flirtual:photos_from_world_named.description: Title of a Premium dialog listing other users' profile pictures taken in the same VRChat world. Followed by a "Premium" badge.

world.meaning: VRChat world name (proper noun, not translated)

flirtual:pickle_capricious_cemetery_name.description: Smaller hint text under the "I agree" checkbox label on sign-up; it continues that label's sentence ("I agree to the Terms… and I'm at least 18 years of age"). Ticking the box is the user's legal consent and age confirmation; sign-up is blocked without it.

tags.terms: Underlined link to the Terms of Service page; wraps the link text
tags.privacy: Underlined link to the Privacy Policy page; wraps the link text

flirtual:pickle_capricious_cemetery_name.lengthNote: Wraps at about 34 characters per line

flirtual:pink.description: Name shown on a brand color swatch for Flirtual's pink (#E9658B).

flirtual:pipe_land_teeny_hypnotic.description: Banner on someone's profile page (opened directly, not in the browse queue) saying what you already did to them, with an Undo button beside it. "liked" = you sent a Like (dating interest), "homied" = you sent a Homie (friendship interest), other = you passed (skipped) them. Translate each select branch.

status.meaning: ICU select: liked, homied, or other (passed); keep the keys untranslated

flirtual:pleasant_ugliest_expert_camera.description: Banner across the top of the website when the site's language differs from the user's browser/preferred language, offering to switch. Was shown in the preferred language rather than the current one. Not referenced in the current code.

current.meaning: Name of the language currently shown, in the reader's language

preferred.meaning: Name of the user's preferred language, in the reader's language

tags.bannerLink: Link that switches the site to the preferred language

flirtual:popular_interests.description: Category heading in the advanced filter tag picker, grouping the most common predefined interest tags (available without Premium; the remaining interests are a separate Premium category).

flirtual:practical.description: Personality trait pill on a profile, derived from the personality quiz: the low end of openness (down-to-earth, prefers the familiar), the opposite of "Open-minded". Describes the profile owner, whose gender varies; prefer a form that works for any gender. Also shown on the Apple Watch app.

flirtual:premium.description: Name of Flirtual's paid subscription tier. Used as a menu item and page title for the subscription page, and as a small badge linking there next to Premium-only features (filters, matchmaking priorities, profile colors). Product name; keep consistent everywhere.
flirtual:premium.lengthNote: Also a small pill badge; keep short

flirtual:premium_advanced_filters_descri.description: Description under the "Advanced filters" benefit heading, shown to non-subscribers. "Games" are the VR games listed on profiles. Followed by a space and the link "(Check this out for free)".

flirtual:press.description: Link to and title of the Press page, with press coverage and media contact info for journalists. Means the news media, not the verb "to press".

flirtual:press_kit.description: Section heading on the Press page above a Download button for a ZIP of logos and media assets for journalists.

flirtual:pretty_in_pink.description: Name of a preset profile color gradient (hot pink to light pink); a nod to the film/song title "Pretty in Pink". Creative name; adapt freely to fit the colors.
flirtual:pretty_in_pink.lengthNote: Maintainer: keep within ~15 characters so it fits above the swatch

flirtual:pretty_last_shrike_bend.description: First paragraph of the "Out of profiles" card in Homie Mode (friend-finding): the user has seen every available profile.

flirtual:preview_tag_1.description: Sample personality tag (adjective describing a person) shown as a small pill in the profile color preview, imitating the tags on a real profile. Any short, natural tag works.

flirtual:preview_tag_2.description: Sample interest tag (dancing as a hobby/activity) shown as a small pill in the profile color preview, imitating the interest tags on a real profile.

flirtual:preview_tag_3.description: Sample interest tag (Japanese animation as an interest) shown as an unselected-style pill in the profile color preview, imitating the interest tags on a real profile.

flirtual:preview_tag_4.description: Sample game tag shown as a small pill in the profile color preview. VRChat is a social VR game's official name; keep it unchanged.

flirtual:previous.description: Goes back one step: the back button with a left arrow in the multi-page "What's new" announcements dialog (pairs with "Next"), and the screen-reader label of the left arrow in a profile photo slideshow.

flirtual:price_listen_wise_communicate.0.description: Alt text and hover tooltip for a photo in the event gallery at the bottom of the About page: Flirtual's 12-hour launch party in VRChat on Valentine's Day 2022, co-hosted with Vanguard (a VRChat club/event group; keep the name).
URL the gallery photo links to (a VRChat world page). Not visible text; copy it unchanged.

flirtual:price_listen_wise_communicate.1.description: Alt text and hover tooltip for a photo in the About page event gallery: a speed dating event Flirtual hosts inside VRChat.
URL the gallery photo links to (a VRChat world page). Not visible text; copy it unchanged.

flirtual:price_listen_wise_communicate.2.description: Alt text and hover tooltip for a photo in the About page event gallery: a DJ music night Flirtual hosts inside VRChat.
URL the gallery photo links to (a VRChat world page). Not visible text; copy it unchanged.

flirtual:price_listen_wise_communicate.3.description: Alt text and hover tooltip for a photo in the About page event gallery: Flirtual's booth at VRCon 2022, a convention held inside VRChat. Keep the event name.
URL the gallery photo links to (a VRChat world page). Not visible text; copy it unchanged.

flirtual:price_listen_wise_communicate.4.description: Alt text and hover tooltip for a photo in the About page event gallery, linking to a YouTube clip of Flirtual featured on the US TV program "Today" (NBC's Today Show). Keep the program name.
URL the gallery photo links to (a YouTube video). Not visible text; copy it unchanged.

flirtual:price_listen_wise_communicate.5.description: Alt text and hover tooltip for a photo in the About page event gallery: Flirtual at Virtual Market (Vket) 2023 Summer, a large virtual-reality expo held in VRChat. Keep the event name; use its official localized name if one exists (e.g. Japanese バーチャルマーケット).
URL the gallery photo links to (a VRChat world page). Not visible text; copy it unchanged.

flirtual:privacy.description: Noun. Name of the privacy settings page (settings menu item, page heading, browser tab title via "{name} - Flirtual"). Also a small expandable toggle under the geolocation option that reveals how the user's location is protected.

flirtual:privacy_policy.description: Name of Flirtual's Privacy Policy legal document: link in settings and footer, and the title of the /privacy page. Use the standard legal term in your language.

flirtual:privacy_policy_outdated.description: Heading and tab title of the old, superseded June 2023 Privacy Policy page (its body is English-only). "(outdated)" marks it as no longer in effect.

flirtual:product_updates.description: Row label in the notification settings grid, followed by an email checkbox and a push checkbox. Controls the newsletter / announcements about new Flirtual features.
flirtual:product_updates.lengthNote: Row label in a fixed-height grid row beside two checkboxes; should fit on one line on a phone

flirtual:profile.description: The user's own dating profile: label of the native app tab that opens your profile, the link at the top of the profile dropdown menu, and the heading of the settings section with profile-editing pages (Matchmaking, Bio & pics, Interests, etc.).
flirtual:profile.lengthNote: Native bottom tab bar label shared with four other tabs; keep short

flirtual:profile_colors.description: Label above the color picker for the two gradient colors used on the user's own profile, followed by a Premium badge (customizing is a paid feature).

flirtual:profile_link.description: Item in the Copy submenu of the moderator/admin profile dropdown that copies the user's profile link name (custom URL slug) to the clipboard.

flirtual:profile_picture.description: Alt text of a profile picture opened full size, in the picture editor and in images inside "What's new" announcements.

flirtual:profile_pictures.description: Label of the image uploader for the user's profile pictures (VR avatar screenshots).

flirtual:prompts.description: Label of the profile section where the user picks question prompts and writes answers shown on their profile (like "My ideal VR date is…"), with an "Add" button beside it. Noun, not the verb.

flirtual:proof_east_termite_pave.description: Hint under the "Bio" field describing what makes a good profile biography.

flirtual:proof_knotty_cockroach_commend.description: Explanation under the playlist section heading on the Connections page. The service names are brands; keep them as written.

flirtual:purchase.description: Small button on the Lifetime plan card (a one-time purchase, not a recurring subscription). Recurring plans use "Subscribe" instead; an owned plan shows "Manage".

flirtual:push_notifications_blocked.description: Hint shown in the iOS/Android app only, below the notification grid, when the user selected push notifications but has blocked notifications for the app at the operating-system level.

tags.settings: Underlined inline button that opens the phone's notification settings for the Flirtual app

flirtual:queue_fallback_notice.description: Dismissible banner above the browse cards explaining that the user ran out of profiles matching their filters, so the app is now showing profiles outside them. "We" is Flirtual.

flirtual:queue_fallback_notice_details.description: Expandable explanation revealed by "More info" in the expanded-search banner: which filters are now relaxed (age range and Premium advanced filters) and that the best matches still come first.

flirtual:queue_liking_streak_notice.description: Warning banner above the browse cards shown after the user has Liked 8 or more profiles in a row without passing. Warns that liking indiscriminately can reduce how often their profile is shown to others.

flirtual:quiet_gross_skate_honor.description: Intro above the personality questions, explaining they're used for matchmaking and are based on the Big Five personality model. "Vibe with" is slang for getting along well.

flirtual:quiet_lazy_marten_amuse.description: Section heading on the Events page for Flirtual's VRChat worlds. A "world" is VRChat's term for a virtual place users visit; use the term VRChat uses in your language. VRChat is a proper name.

flirtual:quiet_quaint_whale_rest.description: Speech bubble from Flirtual's mascot (Flitty, wearing a hard hat) in the error dialog, above the technical error message. Said by the mascot in first person.

flirtual:ranked.description: Joke label (April Fools 2024 ranked mode) shown on the dating-mode switch in the main navigation, paired with "Casual" on the friends (Homie) mode switch. Means the competitive ranked game mode in video games.
