flirtual:refresh.description: Primary button in the website's "new version available" dialog. It reloads the page to load the new version. The app versions show "Update" here instead.
flirtual:refresh.lengthNote: Shares a row with "Not now" in a narrow dialog

flirtual:refresh_the_app.description: Clickable troubleshooting step (with a reload icon) that reloads the app, in the error dialog and error page in the native apps, and in the "taking longer than usual" tips on the loading screen. Imperative.

flirtual:refresh_the_page.description: First item in the troubleshooting list on the web error dialog and error page: a clickable action (with a reload icon) that reloads the page, followed by a period outside the string. Native apps show "Refresh the app" instead. Imperative.

flirtual:relationship_type.description: Label of an optional select for whether the user is monogamous or non-monogamous, and of the matching Premium advanced filter.

flirtual:relationship_types.description: Matchmaking priority slider label: weight given to both people looking for the same kinds of relationship (serious dating, casual VR dating, hookups, friends). A multiplier is shown on the same line.

flirtual:reliable.description: Personality trait pill on a profile, derived from the personality quiz: high conscientiousness (dependable, organized), the opposite of "Free-spirited". Describes the profile owner, whose gender varies; prefer a form that works for any gender. Also shown on the Apple Watch app.

flirtual:remark_butterfly_sum_seasonal.description: Body of the post-checkout success banner on the subscription page, under "We've received your order." The app polls for up to a minute for the purchase to activate.

tags.contact: Link to the Flirtual support/help site; wraps the link text

flirtual:remind_me_later.description: Button in the safety reminder about a Discord username in the profile that dismisses it for 30 days.
flirtual:remind_me_later.lengthNote: Shares a row with "Edit profile" in a narrow dialog

flirtual:remove.description: Button next to "Update location" that deletes the user's saved location. The object is the location.

flirtual:removed_connection.description: Confirmation toast after the user unlinks an external account (Discord, Apple, Google, etc.) from their Flirtual account.

flirtual:removed_item.description: Toast after the user deletes a passkey whose authenticator is recognized. The item is the authenticator's product name.

item.meaning: Name of the password manager or device the passkey was stored in

flirtual:removed_passkey.description: Toast after the user deletes a passkey whose authenticator name is unknown.

flirtual:renewal_pending.description: Status line under the plan name when the subscription's renewal payment is still being processed or retried.

flirtual:renews_in_days.description: Status line under an active auto-renewing plan's name. Keep the ICU plural structure, including the =0 case.

count.meaning: Whole days until the subscription renews (counts days)

flirtual:report.description: Verb: report this user to moderators for breaking the rules. Button with a flag icon on another user's profile (also when blocked), the submit button of the report dialog, and on the watch app a button, the report screen's title, and its send button.
flirtual:report.lengthNote: Also used as a watch screen title; keep it short

flirtual:report_details_optional_placeho.description: Placeholder in the "Details" text area of the report dialog when the chosen report reason doesn't require details; also the text-input prompt on the Apple Watch.

flirtual:report_details_required_placeho.description: Placeholder in the "Details" text area of the report dialog when the chosen report reason requires details; also the text-input prompt on the Apple Watch.

flirtual:report_profile.description: Title of the dialog for reporting another user's profile to moderators; also the section header of the report-reason list on the Apple Watch.

flirtual:resend_code.description: Small button under the code boxes that emails a new login code.

flirtual:resend_in.description: Disabled state of the Resend code button during the 60-second cooldown; the number counts down every second.

seconds.meaning: Number of seconds left before a new code can be requested (bare number, no unit shown)

flirtual:reset_passes.description: Button (trash icon) that undoes all the user's passes so skipped profiles can show up again in browsing; also the confirm button in the "Are you sure?" dialog. "Passes" is the plural noun of the skip action in browsing.

flirtual:reset_password.description: Heading (and browser tab title) of the page where a logged-out user requests a password reset email, and where they set the new password after following the email link.

flirtual:resubscribe.description: Small button under a lapsed subscription in the "Inactive subscription" section; buys the same plan again.

flirtual:rise_and_shine.description: Name of a preset profile color gradient (soft peach to pale yellow, like a sunrise); "Rise and shine" is an English wake-up phrase. Creative name; adapt freely to fit the colors.
flirtual:rise_and_shine.lengthNote: Maintainer: keep within ~15 characters so it fits above the swatch

flirtual:role.description: Category heading in the advanced filter tag picker, only for users with the adult NSFW feature on, grouping BDSM roles: Dominant, Submissive, Switch. "Role" means BDSM role, not a job or game role.

flirtual:rotate_90.description: Button in the upload widget's image editor that rotates the picture a quarter turn before upload.
flirtual:rotate_90.lengthNote: Short tool button/tooltip in the image editor

flirtual:round_crazy_haddock_mix.description: Message on the page-not-found (404) screen, above a "Back to browsing" button. Also shown when opening a profile that was deleted or hidden.

flirtual:round_stout_iguana_stab.description: Paragraph on the dating "Out of profiles" card suggesting the user broaden their matchmaking filters (age range, gender, etc.) to see more people.

tags.settingsLink: Link to the matchmaking settings page (/settings/matchmaking); wraps the link text

flirtual:royal_home_leopard_tickle.description: Success toast after the user opens a valid email confirmation link; they are then taken to the browsing page.

flirtual:royal_house_peacock_roar.description: Title of two onboarding tour steps: one pointing at the Like button (in Date Mode) and one pointing at the Homie button (in Homie Mode). Means "interested in this person?".

flirtual:sad_spare_grizzly_twirl.description: Onboarding tour step pointing at the profile/settings menu button. Premium is Flirtual's paid subscription.

flirtual:safe_good_rat_bask.description: Explanation under "Matchmaking priorities": each factor has a slider; non-Premium users can only change the location slider.

flirtual:salty_novel_octopus_surge.description: Toast after a new account confirmation email is sent, either by pressing "Send again" or after adding an email address.

flirtual:same_honest_seal_renew.description: Main headline at the top of the homepage, over a background video. Contrasts dates in VR with real relationships.

tags.highlight: Highlighted second half, shown in the brand pink gradient; on wide screens it starts on its own line

flirtual:save.description: Generic save button (verb, imperative). Used to submit the new password when the user is adding a password for the first time, as the save button of the photo editor (crop/rotate) when uploading profile pictures, and to submit forms inside "what's new" news dialogs.

flirtual:save_percent.description: Discount badge in the top-right corner of a multi-month plan card, showing how much cheaper it is than paying monthly.

number.meaning: Discount percentage versus the monthly plan, a whole number

flirtual:save_percent.lengthNote: Rotated 45° inside a small triangular corner ribbon and never wraps; keep it very short

flirtual:save_settings_confirmation.description: Question in the unsaved-settings dialog, answered with Yes (save, then continue) or No (continue without saving).

flirtual:saved.description: Confirmation toast shown after the user saves the form embedded in a news item (location/timezone or relationship tags). Means "your changes were saved".

flirtual:sea_giant_anteater_slurp.description: Paragraph on the dating "Out of profiles" card suggesting the user come back later or invite friends to grow the user base. Follows the filters suggestion, hence "Or".

flirtual:search.description: Staff-only link (moderators) to the moderator user-search page for looking up accounts. Noun/page name, shown next to a magnifying-glass icon.

flirtual:search_image_external.description: Moderator-only tooltip on a search icon that runs a reverse image search for the photo on external search engines in new tabs.

flirtual:search_image_internal.description: Moderator-only tooltip on an icon that searches Flirtual's own database for matching or similar profile pictures.

flirtual:search_interests.description: Placeholder in the search box for filtering the list of interests.

screens: dialog: Out of likes and passes
flirtual:seconds.description: Small unit label above the seconds number in a three-box countdown (hours / minutes / seconds) to the daily limit reset. Stands alone as a column header; the number below can be any value, so use the general plural/unit form.
flirtual:seconds.lengthNote: One of three equal-width columns in a narrow dialog

flirtual:see_who_likes_you.description: Button at the top of the Matches list that opens the Likes You page (Premium) or the subscription page for free users. When counts are available it's followed by "(12❤) (3✌)" counts of dating likes and friend requests.

flirtual:seemly_sticky_frightening_fetch.description: Full text of the Community Guidelines page: rules, the child-safety policy, and how to report and appeal. Keep all tags and their structure. "Report" in quotes is the label of the report button at the bottom of profiles; match that translation. Canada is where Flirtual is hosted.

tags.group: Block grouping a rule's heading and its explanation
tags.h3: Small heading in the final reporting section
tags.mental-health: Link to the in-app Mental health resources page; wraps the link text
tags.terms: Link to the Terms of Service; wraps the link text
tags.privacy: Link to the Privacy Policy; wraps the link text
tags.vulnerability: Link to the GitHub vulnerability-report page; wraps "GitHub"
tags.email: Link to the support ticket form; wraps the link text

flirtual:select_a_country.description: Placeholder of the dropdown where the user picks the country shown on their profile.

flirtual:select_a_language.description: Placeholder of the autocomplete where the user picks up to 5 languages they speak, shown on their profile.

flirtual:select_a_prompt.description: Placeholder of the dropdown in the prompt dialog where the user picks which question to answer.

flirtual:select_a_reason.description: Placeholder in the account-deletion reason dropdown before a choice is made.

flirtual:select_an_option.description: Default placeholder of dropdown menus throughout the app when nothing is selected yet.

flirtual:select_games.description: Placeholder in the autocomplete field where users pick up to 5 VR games they play, while editing their profile or during sign-up onboarding.

flirtual:select_genders.description: Placeholder of the search box that appears after ticking "Other genders", where the user picks additional gender identities that describe themselves.

flirtual:select_interests.description: Placeholder in the empty interest search/select box in the second onboarding step; the user types or picks interests from a dropdown.

flirtual:select_the_platforms_you_use.description: Placeholder of the "VR setup" picker; "platforms" means VR headsets and accessories the user owns.

flirtual:select_timezone.description: Placeholder of the dropdown where the user picks their time zone.

flirtual:select_your_sexualities.description: Placeholder in the "Sexuality" autocomplete field, where the user can pick up to 3 sexual orientations.

flirtual:send_a_message.description: Main button in the "It's a match!" dialog that opens the chat with the new match.

flirtual:send_again.description: Button that resends the account confirmation email.

flirtual:serene_silver.description: Name of a preset profile color gradient (very pale silver to slate gray). Creative name; adapt freely to fit the colors.
flirtual:serene_silver.lengthNote: Maintainer: keep within ~15 characters so it fits above the swatch

flirtual:serious_dating.description: Tag option under "Looking for" in the advanced filters: people seeking a serious relationship that may lead to meeting in person.

flirtual:serious_dating_hint.description: Checkbox option under "I'm open to…": a committed relationship that may lead to meeting in real life. The parenthetical clarifies the difference from VR-only dating.

flirtual:session.description: No current use found in the web app or watch code; the batch's references are API paths and cache keys named "session", not this string. As a word, it means a login session.
flirtual:session.resolved: Not rendered by current code; translate plainly as a login session. (Possible removal reported to the maintainer.)

flirtual:settings.description: Name of the app's Settings area: label of the gear-icon tab in the native app's bottom tab bar, the item in the profile dropdown menu, the settings sidebar heading, and part of the browser page title.
flirtual:settings.lengthNote: Native bottom tab bar label shared with four other tabs; keep short

flirtual:sexualities.description: Category heading in the advanced filter tag picker, grouping sexual orientation tags (Premium-only category).

flirtual:sexuality.description: Label for the sexual orientation field when editing the profile (options like Bisexual, Gay, Lesbian).

flirtual:sexuality_privacy.description: Label of a dropdown choosing who can see the user's sexuality on their profile: anyone on Flirtual, matches only, or just me.

flirtual:sexuality_privacy_hint.description: Question shown as a hint next to the "Sexuality privacy" label, above the who-can-see dropdown.

flirtual:share.description: Button with a share icon. On your own profile it opens the share dialog; inside the dialog it opens the device's native share sheet with your profile link.

flirtual:shared_custom_interests.description: Matchmaking priority slider label: weight given to having user-written (custom) interest tags in common. A multiplier is shown on the same line.

flirtual:shared_interests.description: Matchmaking priority slider label: weight given to having predefined interest tags in common. A multiplier (e.g. "1.5x") is shown on the same line.

flirtual:shared_languages.description: Matchmaking priority slider label: weight given to speaking the same languages. A multiplier is shown on the same line.

flirtual:shared_vr_games.description: Matchmaking priority slider label: weight given to having VR games in common with the other person. A multiplier (e.g. "1.5x") is shown on the same line.

flirtual:sharp_calm_stork_cry.description: Premium benefit, prefixed by a 🎚️ emoji. For subscribers it links to the matchmaking settings, where they can weight which factors matter most in their matches; for non-subscribers it is a bold heading followed by a description.

flirtual:sharp_gray_sloth_clasp.description: Button on the Homie Mode "Out of profiles" card that switches back to dating mode (/dates).

flirtual:show.description: Tooltip on the eye icon in password fields while the password is hidden; clicking reveals the typed characters. Pairs with "Hide".

flirtual:show_nsfw.description: Label of an on/off switch on the NSFW settings page. When turned on, the dom/sub and kink fields appear below it. "NSFW tags" are the opt-in adult (kink) tags users add to their profiles.

flirtual:show_nsfw_hint.description: Hint text under the on/off switch labelled "Show NSFW tags on profiles?". NSFW tags are the opt-in adult (kink) tags people can add to their profiles; this controls whether the user sees them on other people's profiles.

flirtual:sidequest.description: Store name on an app download button, under a small uppercase "Download on" line. SideQuest is a third-party app store for Meta Quest headsets; proper name, don't translate.

flirtual:sign_up.description: Primary call-to-action button for logged-out visitors on the homepage; opens the account registration page (/sign-up). Sits beside the "Log in" button, and the Flitty mascot peeks out from behind it.
flirtual:sign_up.lengthNote: Small button taking half the width of a two-button row on mobile

flirtual:silly_petty_meerkat_hug.description: Body of the "Complete your profile" card shown instead of profiles in the browse screen when the user's profile is incomplete; followed by a "Finish profile" button. "Hidden" means other users can't see the profile.

flirtual:since_date.description: Status line under a plan's name giving the date it was purchased; used for one-time purchases such as Lifetime, which never expire. Keep the ICU date format "{date, date, long}" unchanged.

date.meaning: Date the plan was purchased, rendered as a long localized date

flirtual:small.description: Name of the 3rd of seven text-size steps (just below default) on the Font size slider, shown beside the label while selected. Order: Tiny, Extra small, Small, Default, Large, Extra large, Huge.
flirtual:small.lengthNote: Short label at the end of a label row

screens: dialog: Out of likes and passes
flirtual:small_drab_rooster_drum.description: Paragraph in the daily-limit dialog, shown only in dating mode, suggesting the user switch to Homie Mode (friend-finding) to keep browsing. Same English as main_large_goat_succeed but used in a dialog.

tags.browseLink: Link to Homie Mode browsing (/homies); wraps the feature name "Homie Mode"

flirtual:smart_bland_husky_scold.description: Explanation above the "Reactivate account" button: reactivating makes the user's hidden profile show up to others again.

flirtual:snowfall.description: Name of a seasonal effect that shows falling snow animated over the app. On the Appearance page it is an on/off switch shown only Dec 24–31; on the hidden Fun stuff page it labels a dropdown (Auto/Always/Never).

flirtual:snowfall_option_always.description: Snowfall dropdown option: show falling snow all year round.

flirtual:snowfall_option_auto.description: Snowfall dropdown option: show falling snow automatically only during the holiday period (Dec 24–31).

flirtual:snowfall_option_never.description: Snowfall dropdown option: never show falling snow.

flirtual:social.description: Category heading in the mobile settings list above links to Flirtual's community and social media: Events, Discord server, VRChat group, X, Bluesky, Instagram.

flirtual:source_code.description: Label in the browser's developer console message, followed by " → " and the link to Flirtual's GitHub repository. Noun (the program's source code).

flirtual:spade_mindless_furry_jeans.description: Smaller hint text under the "Get Flirtual updates" checkbox on sign-up; continues that label's sentence ("Get Flirtual updates with new features, changes, and offers"), then a reassurance on its own line.

tags.br:
Line break; keep it as an empty

pair, it holds no text

flirtual:spade_mindless_furry_jeans.lengthNote: Wraps at about 34 characters per line

flirtual:spare_chunky_cougar_honor.description: Heading over a full-screen slideshow of photos of VR worlds, each captioned with a date activity ("Feed some ducks", …).

flirtual:start_matching.description: Button that takes a logged-in user to browsing profiles (/dates). Shown on the homepage instead of Sign up/Log in, and as the final button of the guided app tour's "Thank you!" step, which ends the tour.

flirtual:stats.description: Admin-only menu item opening the internal statistics page (user and usage numbers). Short for statistics.

flirtual:status.description: Footer link to Flirtual's service status page (status.flirtual.net), showing whether the servers are up or having problems. Not a profile or relationship status.

flirtual:sticks_own_phobic_utopian.description: Instructions above the email field on the password reset request page. The user is logged out; "a link" is sent by email.

flirtual:sticks_protect_zinc_explain.description: Full text of the Privacy Policy (data controller, data collected, legal basis, sharing, rights, retention, California notice, contact), rendered as rich text. Company names and the postal address must stay as-is. The maintainer says don't worry about this one unless you're confident translating legal policies; a machine translation is shown with a disclaimer that the English version governs.

tags.strong: Bold label at the start of a paragraph
tags.br: Line break (self-closing; keep in place within the address)
tags.settings-delete: Link to the account deletion page in Settings
tags.vulnerability: Link to the GitHub security vulnerability reporting page
tags.complaint-ca: Link to the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada
tags.complaint-eu: Link to the list of EU national data protection authorities
tags.complaint-uk: Link to the UK Information Commissioner's Office
tags.complaint-us-ca: Link to the California Attorney General's office

flirtual:stock_topical_mouse_inspire.description: Text on the website's tile for attaching screenshots to a user report: drag files onto it, or click it to choose files. The whole tile is clickable; "browse" isn't a separate link.
flirtual:stock_topical_mouse_inspire.lengthNote: Fits inside a small square tile

flirtual:stock_zany_puma_gulp.description: Description under the "Control your matchmaking priorities" benefit heading, shown to non-subscribers. Followed by a space and the link "(Check this out for free)".

flirtual:stout_last_kudu_bend.description: Heading of the homepage section showing an example profile: users present themselves with whatever VR avatar they choose instead of real photos. Below it, three messages rotate every 5 seconds.

flirtual:stout_tired_warbler_inspire.description: Paragraph on the Homie Mode "Out of profiles" card suggesting the user come back later or invite friends. "homies" means friends (a nod to Homie Mode); ":3" is a cute emoticon.

flirtual:straightforward.description: Personality trait pill on a profile, derived from the personality quiz: low agreeableness (direct, blunt, says what they think), the positively-framed opposite of "Friendly". Describes the profile owner, whose gender varies; prefer a form that works for any gender. Also shown on the Apple Watch app.

flirtual:strip_zesty_bushes_idiotic.description: Dismissable banner across the top of the website prompting the user to install the mobile app. Not referenced in the current code.

tags.bannerLink: Link to the app download page; the whole banner is clickable

flirtual:strong_home_bullock_taste.description: Italic note on another person's profile, above their bio, shown when both you and they have marked themselves as new to VR. Encourages exploring VR together.

flirtual:suave_same_macaw_affirm.description: Bold line at the top of a policy published ahead of its start date, linking to the version currently in force.

date.meaning: Future date the policy starts applying, already formatted for the locale

tags.otherPolicy: Link to the current version of the same policy

flirtual:submissive.description: BDSM role (the person who prefers to be submissive), part of the opt-in adult (NSFW) feature alongside Dominant and Switch. Shown as a profile tag, as an option in the Role advanced filter, and as a matchmaking-priority slider label (shown to dominant users, meaning "prefer submissive people").

flirtual:submit.description: Main button on the login code step that submits the 6-digit code (it also submits automatically when all digits are entered).

flirtual:subscribe.description: Small button on each recurring plan card (monthly, every 3 months, every 6 months) that starts checkout for that plan.

flirtual:such_pink_jan_spur.description: Usage rule under the "Mark only" heading; "these" are the symbol-only logo files shown below it.

flirtual:support.description: Link that opens the customer-support contact widget (or the contact page from the error/maintenance screen). Noun meaning customer support/help, not the verb "to support". In the settings list it sits under the "Help" heading; after a password reset request it is a small button next to "Login".

flirtual:sweet_mellow_ant_hunt.description: Description of The Flirtual Club VRChat world. AudioLink is a VRChat system that makes the world's visuals react to the music (proper name). "Vibe on." is a casual invitation to relax and enjoy the music.

flirtual:sweet_strong_poodle_endure.description: Troubleshooting step in the native apps' error dialog/error page and in the loading-screen tips: update the app, browser and device software. The web version without "your app" is a separate string.

tags.browser-icon: Self-closing browser-window icon placed right before the word for browser; keep it before that word
tags.device-icon: Self-closing phone icon placed right before the word for device; keep it before that word

flirtual:switch.description: BDSM role for someone who enjoys being both dominant and submissive, part of the opt-in adult (NSFW) feature alongside Dominant and Submissive. A noun for the role, not the verb "to switch" or a toggle. Shown as a profile tag, a Role filter option, and a matchmaking-priority slider label.

flirtual:system.description: Theme option that follows the device's system light/dark setting, in the small theme dropdown in the page footer and on login/sign-up cards (with Light and Dark).

flirtual:system_theme_image.description: Not text: the ID of the uploaded screenshot image shown for the System (automatic) theme option. Copy it exactly, unchanged.

flirtual:system_theme_preview.description: Screen-reader alt text for the screenshot of the theme option that follows the device's light/dark setting.

flirtual:talkjs_input_placeholder.description: Placeholder in the message input box of a chat with a match. The chat widget (TalkJS) fills {name} itself.

flirtual:talkjs_match_message.description: Placeholder preview in the Matches list for a new match with no messages yet, and the system message shown at the start of a new chat. Celebrates that both people liked each other.

flirtual:tame_weird_termite_zap.description: Content rules for the profile bio, revealed by "Guidelines" under the "Bio" field. "Soliciting" means asking for money or services.

flirtual:tangy_front_anaconda_dash.description: Label of an on/off switch; switching it on opts the user out of anonymous product usage analytics. A "Learn more" link to the Privacy Policy sits beside it. Keep it a yes/no question whose "on" answer means opting out.

flirtual:teary_cuddly_midge_sew.description: Final confirmation text directly above the Delete account button.

tags.strong: Bold emphasis on the irreversibility sentence

flirtual:tense_active_gibbon_dare.description: Body of a Trust & Safety dialog shown to users whose bio or display name seems to contain their Discord username, advising them to remove it and link their Discord account instead, which reveals it only to matches. Buttons below: "Edit profile" and "Remind me later".

tags.br: Line break; the pairs make blank lines between paragraphs. Keep them as they are
tags.connectLink: Link to the Connections settings page where Discord can be linked

screens: dialog: Out of likes and passes
flirtual:tense_loose_felix_beam.description: Bold label directly above a live countdown (hours / minutes / seconds boxes) until the daily limit resets and the user can browse new profiles again. The colon introduces the countdown.

flirtual:terms_of_service.description: Name of Flirtual's Terms of Service legal document: link in settings and footer, and the title of the /terms page. Use the standard legal term in your language.

flirtual:terms_outdated.description: Heading and tab title of the old, superseded October 2023 Terms of Service page (its body is English-only). "(outdated)" marks it as no longer in effect.

flirtual:that_active_seal_nail.description: Signature at the end of the final onboarding tour note, after "<3", like signing a letter from the company's staff.

flirtual:theme.description: Label above the light/dark/system color theme choices on the Appearance settings page.

flirtual:tidy_known_whale_imagine.description: Body of the first step of the onboarding tour shown to new users on the browse page, under the title "Welcome to Flirtual". ":3" is a cute emoticon (cat face).

flirtual:tidy_wise_robin_urge.description: Name of Flirtual's speed-dating VRChat world. Used as the image description, as a heading, and as a button label that opens the world's VRChat page.
flirtual:tidy_wise_robin_urge.resolved: Keep the VRChat world name in English exactly; the surrounding sentence may explain what it is.

flirtual:time_diff_h.description: Compact time-zone difference between you and the other user, next to a clock icon on their profile photo (whole hours only). Also used on the Apple Watch.

sign.meaning: "+" if they are ahead of you, "-" if behind

flirtual:time_diff_h.lengthNote: Very compact; keep an abbreviation for hours, no spaces

flirtual:time_diff_hm.description: Compact time-zone difference between you and the other user when it includes minutes, e.g. "+5h30" meaning 5 hours 30 minutes ahead. Shown next to a clock icon on their profile photo and on the Apple Watch.

sign.meaning: "+" if they are ahead of you, "-" if behind

flirtual:time_diff_hm.lengthNote: Very compact; keep abbreviations, no spaces

flirtual:timezone.description: Label for the timezone selector on the profile; others see the user's local time difference. Also in onboarding (marked optional) and the 2025 location update announcement.

flirtual:timezone_hint.description: Hint under the Timezone picker. Time zones are listed by city name, and the hint reassures that only the user's local time, not the chosen city, appears on their profile.

flirtual:tiny.description: Name of the smallest of seven text-size steps on the Font size slider, shown beside the label while selected. Order: Tiny, Extra small, Small, Default, Large, Extra large, Huge.
flirtual:tiny.lengthNote: Short label at the end of a label row

flirtual:tips.description: Expand toggle on the empty Matches page that reveals a tip about boosting your profile. Plural noun (advice).

flirtual:tips_and_reminders.description: Row label in the notification settings grid, followed by an email checkbox and a push checkbox. Controls reminder and tip notifications from Flirtual.
flirtual:tips_and_reminders.lengthNote: Row label in a fixed-height grid row beside two checkboxes; should fit on one line on a phone

flirtual:top_big_tern_twist.description: Section heading on the Events page above a description and an embedded Discord event list.

flirtual:touch_grass.description: Name of a preset profile color gradient (brown soil to grass green). "Touch grass" is internet slang telling someone who's online too much to go outside; clicking it plays a hand-touching-grass animation, and clicking it five times opens the hidden Fun stuff settings. A local equivalent joke is welcome.
flirtual:touch_grass.lengthNote: Maintainer: keep within ~15 characters so it fits above the swatch

flirtual:tough_plain_squirrel_persist.description: Section heading on the Connections settings page for linking a music playlist that is displayed on the user's public profile.

flirtual:tough_sleek_wasp_reside.description: Troubleshooting step in the error dialog, error page and loading-screen tips. Imperative.

tags.icon: Self-closing no-Wi-Fi icon placed right before the words for internet connection; keep it before them

flirtual:translate.description: Label in the browser's developer console message, followed by " → " and a link to Flirtual's Weblate project where volunteers can help translate the app. Imperative (help translate), not a button that translates text.

flirtual:trick_or_treat.description: Name of a preset profile color gradient (Halloween orange to purple), named after the Halloween custom. Use your language's Halloween phrase or another fitting name.
flirtual:trick_or_treat.lengthNote: Maintainer: keep within ~15 characters so it fits above the swatch

flirtual:trite_alert_ibex_shine.description: Full text of the Payment Terms page (Premium subscriptions, account deletion, refunds), rendered as rich text. The maintainer says don't worry about this one unless you're confident translating legal policies; a machine translation is shown with a disclaimer that the English version governs.

tags.section: Groups a heading and its paragraphs (layout only)
tags.apple: Link to Apple Support (getsupport.apple.com) for App Store refunds
tags.contact: Link to Flirtual's support ticket form
tags.terms: Link to the Terms of Service page
tags.guidelines: Link to the Community Guidelines page

flirtual:trite_alive_orangutan_foster.description: Red error under the playlist field when the user submits a regular YouTube link; only YouTube Music playlists work. Keep the product names unchanged.

flirtual:trite_awful_marten_lend.description: Warning, prefixed with ⚠️, shown on the reactivate-account page to deactivated users who still have Premium, above a "Manage subscription" button.

flirtual:trust_and_safety.description: Dialog title shown right after the Flirtual logo ("[Flirtual] Trust & Safety"), naming the moderation team that sent the message. Used on warnings from moderators and safety reminders.

flirtual:try_again.description: Retry button: in the error dialog (re-renders the page), on the age-check screen (rechecks the device's age range), and under every error/empty-state message on the Apple Watch.
flirtual:try_again.lengthNote: Button; on the watch it must fit a small screen

flirtual:type_your_custom_interests.description: Placeholder of the free-text custom interests field.

flirtual:unblock.description: Button on the blocked-profile card that removes your block on that user.

flirtual:underage_description.description: Body of a former page shown to accounts suspended for being under 18, pointing them to the suspension email. Not referenced in the current code.

flirtual:underage_title.description: Title of a former page shown to accounts suspended for being under 18. Not referenced in the current code (the page was removed when suspended users could log in to appeal).

flirtual:undo.description: Undo action. In browse and Likes You it's the tooltip of the round undo-arrow button (keyboard shortcut H) that goes back to the previous profile, reversing the last Like/Pass. On someone's profile page it's a button next to "You liked/passed on {name}." that reverses that action. Imperative verb.

flirtual:unmatch.description: Button on a matched user's profile, next to the Message button, that removes the match with that person.

flirtual:unmatched_name.description: Toast confirming you removed your match with someone.

name.meaning: The other user's display name (or "Unnamed user")

flirtual:unnamed_user.description: Fallback shown in place of a person's display name when they haven't set one: in the match dialog, Likes You list, chat header, report/block dialogs, and inserted as the name into toasts like "Blocked {name}". Refers to another user.

flirtual:unsaved_settings.description: Title of a small confirmation dialog when the user moves to the next item or closes the "What's new" announcements after changing a setting inside one without saving.

flirtual:unsudo.description: Staff-only action shown while an admin is impersonating another user's account; clicking it stops the impersonation and returns to the admin's own account. "sudo" is Unix jargon for acting as another user.

flirtual:unsupported_browser.description: Suffix appended after a space to the disabled "Add passkey" button on the website when the browser can't create passkeys, giving "Add passkey (unsupported browser)".

flirtual:unsupported_device.description: Suffix appended after a space to the disabled "Add passkey" button in the iOS/Android app when the device can't create passkeys, giving "Add passkey (unsupported device)".

flirtual:up_to_number.description: Hint shown next to a field label telling the maximum number of items the user may pick (e.g. next to "VR apps/games" or "Interests").

flirtual:update.description: Submit button at the bottom of most settings forms (profile info, bio, interests, matchmaking, privacy, notifications, email, password, connections) that saves the changes. Verb: save/apply changes, not a software update.

flirtual:update_available.description: Title of the dialog shown when a newer version of the website or app has been released, offering the update.

flirtual:update_available_description_na.description: Body of the update dialog in the iOS/Android app when a new store version exists and the user is only browsing, so there's no unsaved work. The "Update" button opens the App Store or Google Play.
Body of the update dialog in the iOS/Android app when the user may be in the middle of something (editing settings, a chat), so they're asked to save first and then update from the app store.

platform.meaning: Device platform; "apple" picks the App Store wording, anything else picks Google Play. Translate the store names in both branches; keep the select syntax.

flirtual:update_available_description_we.description: Body of the update dialog on the website when a new version was deployed and the user is only browsing. The "Refresh" button reloads the page.
Body of the update dialog on the website when the user may have unsaved work (editing settings, a chat), asking them to save before reloading the page.

flirtual:update_email.description: Submit button of the change-email form on the confirm-email page.

flirtual:update_filters.description: Small button in the expanded-search banner that opens the matchmaking filters settings page. Imperative: change your filters.
flirtual:update_filters.lengthNote: Small button sharing a row with "More info"

flirtual:update_location.description: Button under the Location setting when a location is already saved; re-reads the device location and replaces it.

flirtual:update_required.description: Title of the dialog in the iOS/Android app shown when a feature needs a newer app version than the one installed. The imperative is addressed to the user: update the Flirtual app.

flirtual:update_required_description.description: Body of the "update required" dialog in the iOS/Android app, shown when the user tried a feature the installed app version doesn't support.

platform.meaning: Device platform; "apple" picks the App Store wording, anything else picks Google Play. Translate the store names in both branches; keep the select syntax.

flirtual:updates.description: Link to the News page, where Flirtual's announcements and feature changelog posts are listed; also that page's title. Means news/announcements, not software updates to install.

flirtual:updating.description: Replaces the location button's text while the device location is being fetched and saved.

flirtual:upload_pictures.description: Title of the dialog for adding new profile pictures.

flirtual:uploaded_date.description: Moderator-only toolbar under an expanded profile picture, telling when the photo was uploaded. May be followed by "Taken by … in …" on the same line.

uploaded.meaning: Locale-formatted relative time phrase from Intl.RelativeTimeFormat

flirtual:url.description: Means a web link/address (URL). Visible as a menu item in the shield menu on profiles, under Copy, which copies a short link to that profile; sits next to items like "Display name". Also the label of a hidden anti-spam field on the sign-up form that people never see.
flirtual:url.lengthNote: Short dropdown menu item next to a link icon

flirtual:user_deleted.description: Moderator-only toast after deleting a user's account from the moderation menu.

flirtual:user_id.description: Item in the Copy submenu of the moderator/admin profile dropdown that copies the user's internal ID to the clipboard.

flirtual:user_indefinitely_shadowbanned.description: Moderator-only toast after shadowbanning a user with no end date (their profile is hidden from others' browsing without telling them).

flirtual:user_payments_banned.description: Moderator-only toast after blocking a user from making payments (buying Premium).

flirtual:user_payments_unbanned.description: Moderator-only toast after allowing a user to make payments (buy Premium) again.

flirtual:user_unbanned.description: Moderator-only toast after lifting a user's account ban.

flirtual:user_unshadowbanned.description: Moderator-only toast after lifting a shadowban (a hidden restriction that keeps a user's profile out of others' browsing without telling them).

flirtual:vampiric_vibe.description: Name of a preset profile color gradient (blood red to dark red). Creative name; adapt freely to fit the colors.
flirtual:vampiric_vibe.lengthNote: Maintainer: keep within ~15 characters so it fits above the swatch

flirtual:vaporwave.description: Name of a preset profile color gradient (neon pink to aqua) after the retro "vaporwave" internet art/music aesthetic. Usually kept as the loanword.
flirtual:vaporwave.lengthNote: Maintainer: keep within ~15 characters so it fits above the swatch

flirtual:verify_age_description.description: First paragraph on the age verification page, shown to accounts blocked as possibly under 18.

flirtual:verify_age_errored.description: Red error with an alert icon on the age verification page, shown when the last verification attempt failed for a technical reason (not because of age). The buttons below let them try again.

flirtual:verify_age_failed.description: Red error with an alert icon on the age verification page, shown after a verification attempt ended with Yoti unable to confirm the user is 18 or older. The buttons below let them try again.

flirtual:verify_age_more_options.description: Secondary button under "Begin verification" that starts verification with Yoti's other, alternative methods (e.g. other ID types).

flirtual:verify_age_privacy.description: Privacy notice on the age verification page explaining how Yoti, the third-party age verification provider, handles the user's ID documents and selfie. Yoti is a company name; keep it as is.

tags.yotiPrivacyLink: Link to Yoti's privacy information; wraps the link text

flirtual:verify_age_start.description: Main button on the age verification page that starts verification with Yoti's recommended methods (opens Yoti's site or app).

flirtual:verify_age_title.description: Title of the age verification page (and browser tab title), shown to accounts banned or blocked as possibly under 18. Imperative, addressed to the user.

flirtual:verify_age_verified_description.description: Message under "You're verified" after a successful age verification, above a Continue button that returns to the app.

flirtual:verify_age_verified_title.description: Title of the age verification page once the user's age has been verified successfully.

flirtual:verifying.description: Submit button label on the login code step while the entered code is being checked.

flirtual:version.description: Small app version line at the bottom of the settings list (links to the debug page) and on the crash screen. Keep the brand name Flirtual.

version.meaning: Short git commit hash of the running build

flirtual:view_image.description: Hidden dialog title (read only by screen readers) for the full-screen viewer that opens when a profile picture is clicked.

flirtual:voice_spiritual_polite_entertai.description: Accessible description of the wide group photo of the team's avatars in VRChat at the top of the About page.

flirtual:vr_accessories.description: Category heading in the advanced filter tag picker, grouping VR accessory tags such as full-body tracking or haptics (Premium-only category).

flirtual:vr_apps_games.description: Label of the picker where users choose the VR apps and games they play (e.g. VRChat, Rec Room), followed by the hint "(up to 5)". Also the name of a category in the advanced matchmaking filters.

flirtual:vr_platforms.description: Category heading in the advanced filter tag picker, grouping VR headset tags (e.g. Meta Quest, Valve Index).

flirtual:vr_setup.description: Label of the picker where users choose their VR hardware (headsets like Meta Quest and accessories like full-body tracking).

flirtual:vrchat.description: Placeholder in the text field where users enter their VRChat username during profile setup, next to the VRChat logo. VRChat is a VR social app; brand name, normally left untranslated.

flirtual:vrchat_group.description: Link to Flirtual's official group in VRChat (the social VR game), under the "Social" heading; also a section heading on the Events page above a "Join group" button. Keep the brand name VRChat.

flirtual:vrchat_username.description: Line next to a VRChat icon on a profile (visible to matches and on your own profile) showing the person's VRChat username, followed by a copy button.

tags.copy: Wraps the username; links to their VRChat profile (or a VRChat search)

flirtual:want_to_meet.description: Label above checkboxes of genders the user wants to see in matchmaking (e.g. Men, Women, Other genders), completed by those options. Also the heading and tab title of onboarding step 3. The trailing ellipsis signals the sentence continues with the options.

screens: dialog: Out of likes and passes
flirtual:warm_ago_slug_leap.description: Title of the dialog shown when a free user has used up their daily likes/profile views; they can continue when the daily limit resets.

flirtual:warm_gray_poodle_reap.description: Privacy caution under the playlist field: the linked music profile (e.g. its owner name) will be visible to others on the user's Flirtual profile.

flirtual:watch.account_banned.description: Message on the Apple Watch app when the user's account has been banned by moderators. Points them to the iPhone app for the reason and next steps.

flirtual:watch.account_deactivated.description: Message on the Apple Watch app when the user has deactivated (paused/hidden) their own account; they must turn it back on in the iPhone app.

flirtual:watch.active.description: Status shown with a green dot over a profile photo on the Apple Watch app when that person used Flirtual in the last two weeks. Shares one line with the distance and time-difference labels, so it replaces the web app's longer "Active today"/"Active recently".
flirtual:watch.active.lengthNote: Must fit on one line beside a distance and time difference on a watch screen; keep as short as possible

flirtual:watch.come_back_at.description: Second sentence appended (after a space) to "You're out of likes for today." or "You've seen all your profiles for today." on the Apple Watch app, telling the user when the daily limit resets.

time.meaning: Time of day the daily limit resets, already formatted as a short local time by the watch

flirtual:watch.confirm_email.description: Message on the Apple Watch app when the user hasn't confirmed their email address yet (by clicking the link Flirtual emailed them), which blocks browsing.

flirtual:watch.finding_profiles.description: Caption under a loading spinner on the Apple Watch browse screen while the server is still building the user's list of profiles to show.

flirtual:watch.finish_profile.description: Message on the Apple Watch app when the user's profile isn't complete, so they can't browse yet. They must finish the profile setup in the iPhone app.

flirtual:watch.match.description: VoiceOver (screen reader) label for the small heart icon on a conversation row on the Apple Watch, meaning this conversation is with a romantic (Date Mode) match. The alternative for friend matches is "Homie". Noun: a match, not the verb.

flirtual:watch.match_send_failed.description: Error on the Apple Watch "It's a match!" sheet when the first message to the new match couldn't be sent. "Matches" is the conversations list (the watch's Matches tab / the app's Matches page).

flirtual:watch.messages_failed.description: Heading on the Apple Watch Matches tab when the conversation list fails to load. The specific reason appears below it, followed by a Try again button.

flirtual:watch.next_photo.description: VoiceOver (screen reader) action name on a profile's photo on the Apple Watch app; it advances to the person's next photo (sighted users tap the photo).

flirtual:watch.no_matches_detail.description: Detail text under "No matches yet" on the Apple Watch Matches tab, explaining that conversations with matches will appear there.

flirtual:watch.no_matches_title.description: Heading of the empty state on the Apple Watch Matches tab (the conversations list) when the user has no matches yet. A match is when two people both liked each other.

flirtual:watch.out_of_browses.description: Message on the Apple Watch app when the user has reached the daily limit of profiles they can view. Often followed by "Come back at {time}." in the same string, joined with a space.

flirtual:watch.out_of_likes.description: Message on the Apple Watch app when the user has used up their daily limit of likes (the romantic-interest swipe). Shown in an alert after tapping Like or as the browse screen's error text; often followed by "Come back at {time}." in the same string, joined with a space.

flirtual:watch.profiles_failed.description: Heading on the Apple Watch browse screen when loading profiles fails. The specific reason (another error string, e.g. out of likes or no connection) appears below it, followed by a Try again button.

flirtual:watch.queue_empty_detail.description: Detail text under "That's everyone for now" on the Apple Watch browse screen.

flirtual:watch.queue_empty_title.description: Heading on the Apple Watch browse screen when there are no more profiles to show right now, with a sparkles icon and a Try again button.

flirtual:watch.reply.description: Button with a reply-arrow icon at the bottom of an Apple Watch chat; tapping it opens text input (dictation, scribble, keyboard) to send a message to the match. Imperative verb.
flirtual:watch.reply.lengthNote: Single short button label on a watch

flirtual:watch.say_hi.description: Prompt in the text input that opens from the Message button on the Apple Watch "It's a match!" sheet, inviting the user to send a first message to their new match.

flirtual:watch.send_failed.description: Red error text in an Apple Watch chat when the message the user just sent failed.

flirtual:watch.sent.description: Confirmation with a checkmark that replaces the Message button on the Apple Watch "It's a match!" sheet after the first message to the new match was sent (past participle: the message was sent).
flirtual:watch.sent.lengthNote: One short word next to a checkmark

flirtual:watch.sign_in_detail.description: Explanation under the signed-out heading on the Apple Watch app, above a Try again button. Addressed to the user: they must log in on the iPhone app so the watch can pick up the session.

flirtual:watch.sign_in_title.description: Heading on the Apple Watch app when it has no logged-in session. The watch gets the login from the paired iPhone's Flirtual app; below it are the detail text and a Try again button that asks the phone again.
flirtual:watch.sign_in_title.lengthNote: Small watch screen; short headline, wraps if needed

flirtual:watch.something_went_wrong.description: Generic error on the Apple Watch app: fallback message for unknown server errors when browsing, the alert title when blocking someone fails, the heading when report reasons fail to load, and red text when sending a report fails.

flirtual:watch.switch_to_date_mode.description: VoiceOver (screen reader) label for the top-left toolbar button on the Apple Watch browse screen, shown while in Homie Mode (looking for friends). Tapping it switches to Date Mode (looking for romantic partners). "Date Mode" is a product feature name; keep it consistent with the app's other mode names.

flirtual:watch.switch_to_homie_mode.description: VoiceOver (screen reader) label for the top-left toolbar button on the Apple Watch browse screen, shown while in Date Mode. Tapping it switches to Homie Mode, where people look for friends ("homies") instead of dates. "Homie Mode" is a product feature name; keep it consistent with the app's "Homie Mode" string.

flirtual:watch.unreachable.description: Error message on the Apple Watch app when a request fails without a server error code (usually no network). Shown as the detail under "Couldn't load profiles"/"Couldn't load messages", in a chat, or in an alert after tapping Like/Pass.

flirtual:watch.unreachable_detail.description: Detail text under "Can't reach Flirtual" on the Apple Watch app, above a Try again button.

flirtual:watch.unreachable_title.description: Heading on the Apple Watch app when it can't contact Flirtual's servers to check the account at launch, shown with a no-Wi-Fi icon and a Try again button.

flirtual:watch.unread.description: VoiceOver (screen reader) value read on a conversation row on the Apple Watch when it has unread messages. Describes the conversation (adjective).

flirtual:watch.view_profile.description: Link at the bottom of an Apple Watch chat that opens the other person's profile.

flirtual:web_payment_issue.description: Banner at the top of the subscription page, shown only on the website (not inside the iOS/Android apps), saying web checkout is temporarily unavailable.

flirtual:weekly_likes_summary.description: Row label in the notification settings grid, followed by an email checkbox and a push checkbox. Controls a weekly digest of how many people liked the user's profile. "Likes" here means likes received from other users.
flirtual:weekly_likes_summary.lengthNote: Row label in a fixed-height grid row beside two checkboxes; should fit on one line on a phone

flirtual:weird_dizzy_baboon_support.description: Example under "Matchmaking priorities". "Location" in quotes is the label of one of the sliders below; keep it identical to your translation of that slider label.

flirtual:welcome_to_flirtual.description: Title of the first step of the onboarding tour shown to new users on the browse page.

flirtual:white_tasty_trout_gleam.description: Secondary link below the Delete account button leading to the deactivate-account page as a reversible alternative.

flirtual:wide_shy_loris_gleam.description: Hint under "Custom interests" on Apple devices, whose keyboards label the key "Return". Use the key name Apple uses in this language. Non-Apple devices see the same sentence with "Enter".

tags.small: Small-text wrapper around the ⏎ key symbol; keep it right after the key name

flirtual:wide_stock_skate_radiate.description: Confirmation toast after the user saves their answers to the personality questions (yes/no statements used for matchmaking).

flirtual:wise_great_crow_foster.description: Heading of the last section of the branding page, offering the full press kit download.

flirtual:x.description: Link to Flirtual's account on X, the social network formerly called Twitter. It is the brand name, not a letter or a close button; keep it as "X" unless your market officially uses another name.

flirtual:yes.description: Left half of the app's Yes/No toggle switch used for many on/off settings, and the confirm button (save, then continue) in the "unsaved settings" dialog of the What's new announcements.
flirtual:yes.lengthNote: Half of a compact two-option toggle; keep short

flirtual:you_will_be_reminded_in_number_.description: Toast after the user postpones the reminder to remove their Discord username from their profile.

number.meaning: Number of days until the reminder appears again; always 30 today

flirtual:yummy_salty_porpoise_greet.description: Last troubleshooting step in the error dialog, error page and loading-screen tips.

tags.contact: Link to the support contact page; the link text is forced to lowercase by CSS and doesn't wrap

flirtual:zany_watery_zebra_play.description: Technical detail line at the bottom of the error dialog in small monospace text, tap to copy. "Digest" is a short server-generated hash identifying the error.

notifications:bluesky.description: Name of the Bluesky social network, used as a link to Flirtual's Bluesky profile in the email footer, next to Discord, X and Instagram.

notifications:browse_profiles.description: Hidden description in the likes-digest email's schema.org markup for non-Premium users, which inbox apps like Gmail may show next to the action button that opens the Browse page. Imperative. Inserted into a JSON string, so don't use double quotes.

notifications:browse_profiles_to_see_if_.description: For non-Premium users (who can't see who liked them): body of the likes-digest push notification, and a line in the plain-text digest email followed by the Browse link. Browsing means swiping through suggested profiles; if you Like someone who already liked you, it's a match.

HTML lines in the likes-digest email for non-Premium users. The code wraps this whole string in

…

, so the "

" in the middle splits it into two paragraphs; keep it in place. Keep both hrefs unchanged. Premium is Flirtual's paid subscription.

action_url.meaning: Link to the Browse page; goes in the href only

tags.a: First: link to the Browse page, wraps "Browse profiles". Second: link to the Premium subscription page, wraps "upgrade to Premium"
tags.p: Closes the first paragraph and opens the second; the outer tags are added by the code

notifications:confirm_email.body_html.description: HTML body of the email-confirmation email. "Matchmaking" means browsing and matching with people in the app. Keep the HTML and the href unchanged; only translate the paragraph text and the button label.

action_url.meaning: Confirmation link; goes in the href only, don't move or translate it

tags.a: Button-styled link (class="btn") that confirms the email; its text is the button label

notifications:confirm_email.body_text.description: Plain-text version of the email-confirmation email; the link is printed on its own line at the end.

action_url.meaning: Confirmation link, printed as a raw URL

notifications:confirm_email.subject.description: Subject of the email sent after sign-up (or an email change) asking the user to confirm their email address. Also the heading inside the email and the description in inbox action markup, which is a JSON string, so don't use double quotes.

notifications:continue.description: Name of the one-click action button that Gmail and other inbox apps can show next to the email in the inbox list (schema.org markup, not visible in the email body). It opens the email's main link. It's inserted into a JSON string, so don't use double quotes.
notifications:continue.lengthNote: Inbox action button; keep it to one or two words

notifications:daily_profiles_ready.description: Push notification title sent once the user's daily batch of suggested profiles has refreshed (a few hours after the daily reset). Tapping it opens Browse. Body text is daily_profiles_ready_message.

notifications:daily_profiles_ready_messa.description: Body of the push notification saying the daily batch of suggested profiles is ready. Tapping opens Browse. "Matchmaking magic" is a playful way of describing the matching algorithm.

screens: email: ACTION REQUIRED: Your Flirtual account will be deleted soon
notifications:deletion_reminder_670.body.description: HTML body of the first inactivity warning (60 days before deletion). Homie Mode is Flirtual's friend-finding mode; keep it as a feature name. The Log in button is a one-click login link, valid for 30 days. Keep HTML and href unchanged.

action_url.meaning: One-click login link; goes in the href only

tags.a: Button-styled link (class="btn") that logs the user in; its text is the button label

notifications:deletion_reminder_670.body.tone: Warm, welcoming, with a clear deadline

screens: email: ACTION REQUIRED: Your Flirtual account will be deleted soon
notifications:deletion_reminder_670.body.description: Plain-text version of the first inactivity warning (60 days before deletion). Homie Mode is Flirtual's friend-finding mode. The URL at the end is a one-click login link.

action_url.meaning: One-click login link, printed as a raw URL

notifications:deletion_reminder_670.body.tone: Warm, welcoming, with a clear deadline

notifications:deletion_reminder_670.push.description: Body of the push notification sent with the first inactivity warning. Tapping opens the app.
Title of the push notification sent with the first inactivity warning (60 days before deletion). Tapping opens the app.

screens: email: ACTION REQUIRED: Your Flirtual account will be deleted soon
notifications:deletion_reminder_670.subj.description: Subject (and email heading) of the first inactivity warning, sent after 670 days without logging in; inactive accounts are deleted at 730 days. "ACTION REQUIRED" is deliberately in capitals.

screens: email: ACTION REQUIRED: Your Flirtual account will be deleted in one month
notifications:deletion_reminder_700.body.description: HTML body of the second inactivity warning (30 days before deletion). The Log in button is a one-click login link. Keep HTML and href unchanged.

action_url.meaning: One-click login link; goes in the href only

tags.a: Button-styled link (class="btn") that logs the user in; its text is the button label

screens: email: ACTION REQUIRED: Your Flirtual account will be deleted in one month
notifications:deletion_reminder_700.body.description: Plain-text version of the second inactivity warning (30 days before deletion). The URL at the end is a one-click login link.

action_url.meaning: One-click login link, printed as a raw URL

notifications:deletion_reminder_700.push.description: Body of the push notification sent with the second inactivity warning. Tapping opens the app.
Title of the push notification sent with the second inactivity warning (30 days before deletion). Tapping opens the app.

screens: email: ACTION REQUIRED: Your Flirtual account will be deleted in one month
notifications:deletion_reminder_700.subj.description: Subject (and email heading) of the second inactivity warning, sent after 700 days without logging in, 30 days before deletion. "ACTION REQUIRED" is deliberately in capitals.

screens: email: ACTION REQUIRED: Your Flirtual account will be deleted in one week
notifications:deletion_reminder_723.body.description: HTML body of the final inactivity warning (7 days before deletion). Homie Mode is Flirtual's friend-finding mode; keep it as a feature name. The Log in button is a one-click login link. Keep HTML and href unchanged.

action_url.meaning: One-click login link; goes in the href only

tags.a: Button-styled link (class="btn") that logs the user in; its text is the button label

screens: email: ACTION REQUIRED: Your Flirtual account will be deleted in one week
notifications:deletion_reminder_723.body.description: Plain-text version of the final inactivity warning (7 days before deletion). Homie Mode is Flirtual's friend-finding mode. The URL at the end is a one-click login link.

action_url.meaning: One-click login link, printed as a raw URL

notifications:deletion_reminder_723.push.description: Body of the push notification sent with the final inactivity warning. Tapping opens the app.
Title of the push notification sent with the final inactivity warning (7 days before deletion). Tapping opens the app.

screens: email: ACTION REQUIRED: Your Flirtual account will be deleted in one week
notifications:deletion_reminder_723.subj.description: Subject (and email heading) of the final inactivity warning, sent after 723 days without logging in, 7 days before deletion. "ACTION REQUIRED" is deliberately in capitals.

notifications:discord.description: Name of the Discord chat service, used as a link to Flirtual's Discord server in the footer of every email. It sits in a row with X, Bluesky and Instagram; in the plain-text version it's followed by ": " and the URL.
notifications:discord.tone: Brand name: keep as-is unless the service uses a different official name in your language

screens: email: Your email address was changed
notifications:email_changed.body_html.description: HTML body of the email-changed security alert, sent to the previous address. Replies go to the security team.

email.meaning: The new email address now on the account

screens: email: Your email address was changed
notifications:email_changed.body_text.description: Plain-text version of the email-changed security alert, sent to the previous address. Replies go to the security team.

email.meaning: The new email address now on the account

screens: email: Your email address was changed
notifications:email_changed.subject.description: Subject of the security alert sent to the account's old email address after the email is changed. Also shown as the heading inside the email.

notifications:homied_you.description: First line of the new-match email and the body of the push notification, for a Homie Mode (friends-only) match. "Homied you back" is slang: the other person also sent you a Homie, the friend request action, completing the match. Tapping the push opens the conversation.

name.meaning: Display name of the person you matched with

notifications:if_the_link_does_not_work.description: Small footer note in HTML emails that have a main action button (confirm email, reset password, new match, likes digest, deletion reminders). A line break and the full raw URL follow it. "The link above" refers to the button in the email body.

notifications:instagram.description: Name of Instagram, used as a link to Flirtual's Instagram account in the email footer, next to Discord, X and Bluesky.

notifications:its_a_match.description: Subject (and email heading) of the new-match email, and title of the matching push notification, when two users both Liked each other (romantic match). The friend-mode version is its_a_match_homie.
notifications:its_a_match.lengthNote: Also a push notification title; keep short

notifications:its_a_match_homie.description: Subject (and email heading) of the new-match email, and title of the push notification, when the match came from Homie Mode (two users both sent Homie, the friendship-only action). Same words as its_a_match but with a peace-sign emoji instead of hearts; the match is friendly, not romantic.
notifications:its_a_match_homie.lengthNote: Also a push notification title; keep short

notifications:liked_you.description: First line of the new-match email and the body of the new-match push notification, for a romantic match. "Liked you back" means the other person also sent a Like (the action that signals romantic interest), completing the match. Tapping the push opens the conversation.

name.meaning: Display name of the person you matched with

notifications:message.description: Label of the big button in the new-match email, shown next to the matched person's round profile photo; it opens your chat with them. Imperative verb (send them a message), not the noun. Also the inbox action button name in schema.org JSON markup, so don't use double quotes.
notifications:message.lengthNote: Short button label next to an avatar

notifications:new_match.looking_for_date.description: Plain-text line in every new-match email (romantic and friend) suggesting the #date-worlds channel in Flirtual's Discord, which lists VR worlds to visit together. Keep the channel name "#date-worlds" and the URL unchanged.
HTML version of new_match.looking_for_date_ideas. Keep the channel name "#date-worlds" and the href unchanged.

tags.a: Link to Flirtual's Discord server; wraps the words "Discord server"

notifications:or_upgrade_to_premium.description: Last line of the plain-text likes-digest email for non-Premium users, after the Browse link: an upsell for Premium, the paid subscription that shows who liked you. Keep the URL at the end unchanged.

notifications:password_changed.body_html.description: HTML body of the password-changed security alert. Replies go to the security team.

tags.a: Inline link to the forgot-password page; wraps the words for resetting the password

notifications:password_changed.body_text.description: Plain-text version of the password-changed security alert. Replies go to the security team.

action_url.meaning: Link to the forgot-password page, printed as a raw URL mid-sentence

notifications:password_changed.subject.description: Subject of the security alert sent after the account's password is changed. Also shown as the heading inside the email.

notifications:reset_password.body_html.description: HTML body of the password-reset email. The button opens a page where the user sets a new password. Keep the HTML and href unchanged; translate the text and button label.

action_url.meaning: Password-reset link; goes in the href only

tags.a: Button-styled link (class="btn") to the reset page; its text is the button label

notifications:reset_password.body_text.description: Plain-text version of the password-reset email; the reset link is printed on its own line.

action_url.meaning: Password-reset link, printed as a raw URL

notifications:reset_password.subject.description: Subject of the email sent when someone uses "forgot password". Also the heading inside the email and the description in inbox action markup, which is a JSON string, so don't use double quotes.

notifications:see_who_likes_you.description: In the likes-digest email for Premium subscribers only: a link to the Likes page, where Premium users can see exactly who liked them. In the plain-text email it's followed by the URL on the next line. Also the description in inbox action JSON markup, so don't use double quotes.

notifications:see_who_likes_you_and_matc.description: Body of the weekly likes-digest push notification for Premium subscribers; tapping it opens the Likes page, where they can see who liked them and like them back to match. Title is someone_liked_you.

notifications:send_them_a_message.description: Hidden description in the new-match email's schema.org markup, which inbox apps like Gmail may show next to the email's action button. "Them" is the person you matched with. Inserted into a JSON string, so don't use double quotes.

notifications:someone_liked_you.description: Subject and heading of the weekly likes-digest email, and title of the matching push notification. Sent weekly to users whose profile received Likes or Homies this week that they haven't matched with yet. The singular form is used when the count is exactly one and has no number in it.

count.meaning: Number of people who liked or homied the user's profile this week and haven't matched with them yet (always at least 1)

notifications:someone_liked_you.lengthNote: Also a push notification title; keep short
notifications:someone_liked_you.resolved: Where the singular plural form also covers counts above 1 (e.g. ru 21, 31), include %{count} in that form instead of 'Someone'. ja/ko have one form: use the %{count} sentence.

screens: email: Your account has been disabled
notifications:suspended.body_html.description: HTML body of the ban email. Replies go to the moderation team, so "reply to this message" is how the user appeals. Keep the HTML tags and their order.

message.meaning: The ban reason, either a note a moderator typed (usually in English) or, for underage bans, the translated text of suspended.reason.underage

screens: email: Your account has been disabled
notifications:suspended.body_text.description: Plain-text version of the ban email; should match suspended.body_html. Replies go to the moderation team, so replying is how the user appeals.

message.meaning: The ban reason, either a note a moderator typed (usually in English) or, for underage bans, the translated text of suspended.reason.underage

screens: email: Your account has been disabled
notifications:suspended.reason.underage.description: Ban reason for accounts banned as under 18. It fills the %{message} slot after "Reason:" in the ban email, so it starts with a short label ("Underaged.") followed by an explanation. It tells the user they can log in and verify their age to get the account back.

screens: email: Your account has been disabled
notifications:suspended.subject.description: Subject of the email sent when moderators ban a user's account. Also shown as the large heading at the top of the email body.

notifications:this_week_1_person_liked_y.description: First line of the weekly likes-digest email. "Liked or homied" means sent a Like (romantic interest) or a Homie (friend request, from Homie Mode). The singular form hardcodes "1"; in languages where the singular form covers other numbers, use %{count} instead of 1.

count.meaning: Number of people who liked or homied the user's profile this week and haven't matched with them yet

notifications:unsubscribe.description: Footer link in every email that opens the user's notification settings page (/settings/notifications), where they can turn emails off. In the plain-text version it's followed by ": " and the URL.

screens: email: Your Flirtual login code is …
notifications:verification_code.body_htm.description: HTML body of the suspicious-login code email. The code is shown large and bold in its own paragraph; it expires after 15 minutes. "Settings" is the app's Settings area. Replies go to the security team. Keep the inline style attribute unchanged.

tags.p: Paragraph; the one with the style attribute displays the code

screens: email: Your Flirtual login code is …
notifications:verification_code.body_tex.description: Plain-text version of the suspicious-login code email. The code expires after 15 minutes.

screens: email: Your Flirtual login code is …
notifications:verification_code.subject.description: Subject of the email sent when a login looks suspicious and needs a one-time code; the code is in the subject so it can be read from the notification. Also the heading inside the email.

notifications:x.description: Name of the social network X (formerly Twitter), used as a link to Flirtual's X account in the email footer, next to Discord, Bluesky and Instagram. Not a close button and not a letter or variable.
